m300141.気紛れではあるけど、戦闘では頼りになる連中だしね。\n契約を破棄されたりしなくて: They're fickle, but reliable in battle. Good thing the contract wasn't broken…even if they are whimsical.
m300141.流石は天馬騎士団の方々、\n見事な連携でした。: As expected of the Pegasus Knights—splendid coordination.
m300141.演習とは言え、手は抜きませんよ。\n更に磨きを掛けた天馬騎士団の\n連携をとくと: Even though it's an exercise, we won't hold back. Watch the polished coordination of the Pegasus Knights!
m300141.演習通りに飛んだつもりだったのですが……\nすみません、きっと自分がペースを\n: I thought we were following the drill… I'm sorry, I must've thrown off the pace!
m300141.王に尽くしてくれる者達。彼らに応えるのに褒賞や名誉、\nそんなありきたりな物では: Those who devote themselves to the king—reward and honor, those commonplace things, only add weight and sway their hearts. But…
m300141.王子、ごめんね。こうなった以上ケットシー達に\n力を見せて納得させてあげて！: Prince, I'm sorry. Since it's come to this, show Kettsee and the others our strength and convince them!
m300141.王子、ゴブリン達が向かってきます！\n戦いのご準備を！: Prince, the goblins are coming! Prepare for battle!
m300141.王子、気づかれましたか。あなたの闘う様を\n見た兵達が、普段よりも強い力を発揮で: Prince, did you notice? The soldiers watching you fight are unleashing greater strength than usual.
m300141.王子、皆さん！ 今日は私達天馬騎士の\n訓練にお付き合いいただきありがとうござい: Prince, everyone! Thank you for joining us Pegasus Knights for today's training! We appreciate your support!
m300141.王子、空を飛ぶ方々にはアーチャー等遠距離攻撃の\n出来る方が有効です。\n適切な: Prince, those who fly are best supported by archers and other long-range attacks. Please give the appropriate orders!
m300141.王子、野生の魔界ボアに、軽はずみな攻撃は\n控えた方が良いかと思います。\n傷を: Prince, I think you should hold off on a reckless attack against the wild demon boars. If they get hurt they'll become enraged and impossible to control!
m300141.王子、魔界には何やらまだ先があるようです。\n更なる激戦に備え、準備をしておいた: Prince, there still seems to be more to uncover in the Demon World. It might be wise to prepare for further fierce battles.
m300141.王子、魔界ボアが逃げていきます！: Prince, the demon boar is fleeing!
m300141.王子はカノンを守ってあげてくださいね。\nそれでは、行きます！: Prince, please look after Kanon. Here we go!
m300141.王子！ 先ほどの士気高揚本当にお見事でした！\n王子の背中、是非私に守らせて頂け: Prince! Your morale boost earlier was truly spectacular! I'd be honored to protect your back…! I—excuse me, I got a little carried away!
m300141.生涯をかけても、全ての書物を読み解くのは\n困難でしょうね……あれ、この本は？: Even devoting a lifetime, it would be impossible to read every single book… Wait, what's this book?
m300141.砲科学校を卒業する者には、砲科学校卒業生による\n祝砲で送るのが砲科学校のしきた: It's tradition at the Artillery Academy that graduates are sent off with a celebratory salvo fired by the school's own artillery alumni.
m300141.私なんかが、こんなもの……ううん、そうじゃないか。\n皆が認めてくれたんだもん、: Someone like me… receiving something like this… No, that's not it. Everyone's recognized me, so I have to become a cannon-master worthy of this badge… right, Prince?
m300141.私はケットシーなんかよりもっと強そうな召喚獣と\n契約がしたいわね。どこかに良さ: I'd rather contract with a summoning beast that looks stronger than Kettsee. Does anyone know where we might find a good one?
m300141.色々と課題も見えましたね。\nそういえば、今の演習で思いついた\n新しい飛び方な: We've spotted several issues to work on. By the way, the drill just gave me an idea for a new flying technique…
m300141.貴方は砲科学校における全課程を修了し、\n士官として充分な能力を修め\n砲科学校: You have completed every course at the Artillery Academy, attained the requisite abilities as an officer, and hereby graduate.
m300141.資料によると、魔界の深層では特に珍しくもない、\nどこにでも生息する魔物なんだそ: According to the records, in the deeper layers of the demon realm these beasts aren't especially rare—they're found everywhere…
m300141.馬鹿モン！ 逃げたではなイ、\n急いで追わんカー！ あれ一匹仕入れるのに\nいく: You idiots! It's not like they just ran off—chase them quickly! How much do you think it'll cost to capture even one of those!
m300141.騎兵の方々も、訓練を積み一層強くなられた\nそうですしね。私達天馬騎士団も\n負: The cavalry have been training hard and become even stronger, so we Pegasus Knights can't afford to lose.
m300141.魔法都市に集められる叡智の全てが\n保管してある図書館じゃからの。\n世界中の知: This is the library that holds all the wisdom gathered in the Magic City. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say it contains the knowledge of the entire world.
m300141.魔法都市の大図書館……そのようなものが\nあったとは知りませんでしたね。: The Great Library of the Magic City… I had no idea such a place even existed.
m300141.魔物が復活して以降は、これまで起きなかった現象が\n各地で起こっておるからの。魔: Since the goblins revived, we've seen phenomena that never occurred before across the lands. The approaching Demon World and the Demon King's revival are possible causes, but we can't say for sure yet.
m300141.魔物達の襲撃に遭って以来、図書館には\n足を踏み入れておりませんので、未だ魔物と: Since the monster raid, we haven't set foot inside the library, so it's likely still overrun with golems that have turned into monsters.
m300141.魔界に適応した人達は更なる力を得られる……ですか。: So people who adapt to the Demon World can gain greater power…?
m300141.魔界の深層においては、魔界に棲む者、瘴気に\n適応した者達は更なる力を得られる…: It seems to say that in the deep layers of the Demon World, those who have adapted to the miasma can gain greater power… perhaps? It looks like it's describing people who live in the miasma and the Demon World.
m300141.魔界深層……何の知識もなく向かうには、\n危険すぎる場所のようですね。: The deep demon layers… heading there with no knowledge seems far too dangerous.
m300141.！ 一体どのような記述があるのですか、テルマさん！: ! What does it say about the Demon World, Thelma?

m300515.――すべての次元における、\n最強の英雄に変化しようとしている……？: T.O.W.E.R.: —to become the strongest hero in every dimension…?
m300515.――もぐもぐ。\nなるほど、可愛らしく魅力に溢れ、\n皆に好かれるきみらの主人そ:
――Munch munch.
I see, a cute, charming copy that looks just like your beloved master.
m300515.――ヒーロークルスは英雄を学習していた。\n――肉体を模倣し、記憶を学習した。\:
T.O.W.E.R.: —they were learning the heroes.
—mimicking their bodies, learning their memories.
—their ultimate goal… unpredictable.
m300515.――感知できず。\n――反応なし。\n――ヒーロークルスは消滅した。:
T.O.W.E.R.: —undetectable.
—no response.
—The Hero Crusade has vanished.
m300515.――戦友の似姿と言えど、赦しはしない。: —even if you look like a comrade, I won't forgive you.
m300515.――素晴らしい眺めですね。\n東の国と似ているようで、\nそれでも、全く違う世界: ――What a wonderful view. It feels similar to the Eastern lands, yet it's an entirely different world.
m300515.……ありえません。\n超次元生命体は確かにどこかへ転移し、逃げ延びました。:
T.O.W.E.R.: …Impossible.
The extra-dimensional lifeform did indeed teleport somewhere and escaped.
m300515.……これは何か、商機に繋がる予感がするで！: ...I have a feeling this could turn into a business opportunity!
m300515.……モンスター娘たちの猥談を、\nよくここまで聞こえの良い言葉に翻訳できるわね。: ……You can translate the monster girls' lewd talk into such pleasant words, huh.
m300515.ああ、あたしたちの世界には、\n自然や魔力が意思を持った、\nエレメンタルという: Ah, in our world there are elementals—nature and magic that have wills of their own.
m300515.ああ。\nもちろんニーヴ、きみからも、\n仲間への愛情が常々感じられると――:
Ah.
Of course, Neve, I always feel your affection for our comrades—
m300515.あたしはその中でも、混沌のエレメンタルに……。\nえっと、好かれているというか、: I'm one of those chaos elementals... um, I guess I'm liked—or maybe possessed. It's kind of like family, I suppose.
m300515.あら、王子もやはり、\n巨大化には心惹かれるものがあるのでしょうか？: Ah, Prince, you too seem drawn to the allure of enlargement, don't you?
m300515.いいえ、分かります。\nおそらく、彼らは――:
T.O.W.E.R.: No, I understand.
Most likely, they—
m300515.うるさい！ 混沌霊ぶつけるわよ！？: Shut up! I'll throw a chaos spirit at you!?
m300515.えぇぇ……あたし、人付き合い苦手なの。\n見てよあの仲良しな様子。\nいかにも戦: Ugh… I'm terrible at socializing. Look at how close they are. It's like a reunion of old comrades or something.
m300515.えっ、ちょっと！\n商売とか興味なっ、あっ、あわわっ！？: Hey, wait! I'm not interested in selling—ah, ahh!
m300515.えっ、なっ、ちょっと！\nどういう抱き上げ方よそれ！ 離してー！: Hey, wait! What kind of hug is that! Let go!
m300515.おちゃらけていても、\n少々下ネタの分量が多くとも、そこには愛が感じられる。: Even if it's goofy, even if there's a lot of dirty jokes, you can feel the love there.
m300515.おっ、せや、気になっとったんや。\nそのコントンレーっちゅーのはなんなんや？: Oh, right, I've been wondering. What's this “kontonrei” thing?
m300515.くくくっ、怖くて声も出ませんか？\n普段から無口らしいけど！: Kukuku, you're scared so you can't even speak? I heard you're usually quiet!
m300515.くくっ、はははっ。\nもはや密猟者たちも我が手中！: Kukuk, hahaha. The poachers are already in my grasp!
m300515.じゃあ、あなただけ行ってらっしゃい。\nほら、ちっこいビビ神とハイタッチとか。: Then you go alone. Come on, give a high-five to that tiny Bibi-god.
m300515.せやせや。\nそのうえ密猟者まで従えとって、\nこんなん解釈不一致もええとこや！: Exactly. And on top of that, you've got poachers following you—this kind of contradictory interpretation is just perfect!
m300515.ぜひぜひこの上に乗って……っと、\n一応先に聞きますが、高いところ大丈夫ですかー: Please hop on up here… but first, may I ask, are you okay with heights?
m300515.そりゃあわたくし、城娘ですので！\n天下の大坂城が誇るステージ衣装、とくとご覧あ: Well, of course I'm a castle maiden! Behold the stage costume that the great Osaka Castle of the realm boasts♪
m300515.そんな高望みしたら、\nパルセとメカニック陣が連日徹夜し始めるわよ？: If you keep dreaming like that, Pulsar and the Mechanics will start pulling all-nighters every day, you know?
m300515.だから、こんなに親身になってるのね。: So that's why you're being so caring.
m300515.では……考えられることは――: T.O.W.E.R.: Then… the only explanation is—
m300515.ではでは、そんなおふたりを、\n空の旅にご招待～♪: Well then, let me invite you two on a skyward journey～♪
m300515.どこの世界でも、\n商人というのはたくましいんですねぇ……。: Merchants are resilient, no matter which world they're in...
m300515.ははっ、確かに。\nところで、祝勝会に混ざらなくていいのか？: Haha, true enough. By the way, aren't you going to join the victory celebration?
m300515.はははっ。\n仲間との戯れには積極的に参加するものだ。\n王子！ 殿！ 少年！: Hahaha. You have to get in on the fun with your teammates. Prince! Lord! Boy! Include us too!
m300515.ふっふっふ、美少年騎士団いちの子分！\nこのアタシ、エロイーズの出番だなぁ！！: Heh heh heh, the number-one minion of the Beautiful Boy Knights! This is Eloise's moment!!
m300515.ふむ……。\nできればすぐにでもトドメを刺したいが――: Hmm… If possible I'd like to finish them off right away—but…
m300515.ほうほうほう！\nつまりモンスター娘ならぬ、\nモンスター憑依娘っちゅーことか！: Hohoho! So basically, instead of a monster girl, you're a monster-possessed girl!
m300515.むぅ……。\nドーンブリンガーで次元も超えられたらいいのだが。: Mmm… If only the Dawn Bringer could let us cross dimensions.
m300515.むぅ。そうだな、じゃあ、行くとしよう。: Mmm. Yeah, then I guess I'll go.
m300515.よっしゃさっそく商談や！\nええ商売させてもらいまっせ♪: Alright, let's get down to business! I'll make us a great sale♪
m300515.カミラさん！ エロイーズさん！\nメイジーさん！ 出番ですよ！: Camilla! Eloise! Meiji! It's our turn!
m300515.ニーヴ印の混沌スキュウ！\nこれや、次の大ヒット商品間違いなしやー！: Neve-branded Chaos Squeeze! This is guaranteed to be the next big hit!
m300515.ハッハァ！ やってみせてくださいよ！\nそれでこそ王子さんだ！: Ha ha! Show me what you've got! That's the Prince I know!
m300515.ヒーロークルスの痕跡は――: T.O.W.E.R.: Traces of the Hero Crusade—
m300515.世界の危機を幾度も救ったという真の英雄、\n王子さんを倒し、最強の座はいただきま: The true hero who has saved the world countless times, Prince, I'll defeat you and claim the top spot!
m300515.何だか変な感じですけど、\nまぁ美少年くんが言うなら大丈夫なんですかね？\n美少: It feels weird, but if the beautiful boy says it's okay, then I guess it's fine. I'm Meiji, the wisdom officer of the Beautiful Boy Knights.
m300515.俺たちの名を騙るまでは、まだいい。\nだが、戦うことを望まぬ者を支配し、\n無理: It's fine as long as you use our name. But if you control those who don't want to fight and force them into battle—
m300515.城娘の皆さんは、\n巨大化することができるのは知っていましたが、\n改めて見ると: I knew castle maidens could enlarge themselves, but seeing it again really surprises me.
m300515.大丈夫や！\nすぐ終わらせるさかい！: No worries! We'll wrap it up in a flash!
m300515.大坂城さん、とっても、その、大きいですね……？: Osaka Castle, you're… uh, really big…?
m300515.彼女らが少年の偽物に\n困っているのが伝わってくるからな。: I can tell they're troubled by the boy's impostor.
m300515.戦い続け、相容れぬものを斬り続けたその力！\n必ず奪い取ってみせますよ！: Your power that keeps fighting and cutting down anything you can't accept! I'll definitely take it for myself!
m300515.戦友同士には違いないだろう？\nそれに、ニーヴも一緒に戦った仲間だ。: They're definitely comrades, right? And you, Neve, fought alongside them too.
m300515.日の本の素晴らしい景観、\nたっぷり心に刻んでいってくださいね♪: Take in the splendid scenery of the Land of the Rising Sun and etch it deep in your hearts♪
m300515.王国にも背丈の大きなくぐつや、\n超古代文明の巨大な機械の方がいますが……。: In our kingdom there are also towering giants and massive machines from the ancient civilization…
m300515.生命活動が極端に低下しているから、\nそのせいで場所の特定ができていないみたい。: Their life signs are extremely low, so that's why we can't pinpoint their location.
m300515.目下、ヒーロークルスの潜伏先を調査中だって。\nただ、３個体それぞれが致命傷に近: Apparently they're currently investigating the Hero Crusade's hideout. But each of the three units has taken near-fatal damage and are basically immobilized.
m300515.美少年騎士団？ なんですそれ？\nともかく美少年くんの愛のおもちゃ、カミラです。: Beautiful Boy Knights? What's that? Anyway, I'm Camilla, the beautiful boy's love toy. Nice to meet you all, even if only briefly.
m300515.良かったぁ～。\nささ、足元に気をつけてどうぞー。: Good～. Careful with your footing, then.
m300515.英雄たる彼らの力を学び、束ね――: T.O.W.E.R.: …learned the heroes' power and gathered it—
m300515.補給も情報交換も終わったし、\nさっそく偽物を探しに行きたいんだが。: We've finished resupplying and exchanging intel, so let's go find the impostor right away.

m400155.――王子の身に危険が迫った際は、\nこのダリューン、必ずや馳せ参じると約束します: —Should danger approach you, Prince, I, Daryun, promise to rush to your aid.
m400155.……しかし、このまま終わりとあらば、\n戦士の中の戦士（マルダーンフ・マルダーン: …However, if this were to end here, it would disgrace the nickname “Warrior among warriors” (Mardanf Mardan)…
m400155.おかげで、ルシタニア軍を退けるだけでなく、\n己が世界への帰参の目処もつきました: Thanks to you, not only have we repelled the Lucitania forces, but we also have a prospect of returning to my own world.
m400155.このまま放っておくには、\nあまりにも危険かと……。: Leaving it as is would be far too dangerous…
m400155.このダリューン……我がご主君、\nアルスラーン殿下のもとへと帰参し、\n無事を報: I, Daryun… must return to my lord, Prince Arslan, and report my safe return; that is my urgent priority.
m400155.それでは、これにて失礼いたします。\n王子、貴国に栄光あらんことを……。: With that, I take my leave. Prince, may glory shine upon your nation…
m400155.先刻、見回りの兵たちから\n領内において異界の門が\n出現したとの情報が上がって: Just now, our patrol soldiers reported that a portal to another world has appeared within our territory.
m400155.本来ならば、この恩義に報いるまでは、\n此の地に留まり、\n武働きをするのが条理: Normally, it would be proper to stay here and continue fighting until I can repay this debt…
m400155.然らば、無礼を承知で、\n私は自分の世界へと戻らせていただき申す。: Therefore, with all due disrespect, I shall return to my own world.
m400155.王子、改めて此度のご助力、\n深く感謝申し上げます。: Prince, once again I deeply thank you for your assistance this time.
m400155.王子、申し訳ありませんが、\n至急、出立の準備をお願い致します！: Prince, I'm sorry, but please make immediate preparations to set out!
m400155.現状においては、異界の門からの\n魔物出現の報は受けていませんが……: So far we haven't received any reports of monsters emerging from the portal…

m400218.それではこれより、\n『大討伐ミッション』を開始いたします！: Then, let's commence the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400218.だからこそ、今再びの大演習なのです！: That's exactly why we need another grand exercise now!
m400218.つまり、自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要となります。: In other words, crushing as many foes as possible matters more than minimizing our own casualties.
m400218.ですが、新たなる力の獲得は、\n同時に新たな災いの源ともなります。: But gaining new power also brings new sources of trouble.
m400218.ですので、『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士や、\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を備え: Therefore, I recommend adding soldiers with the “Request Reinforcement” skill and Valkyries that boost deployment costs to your team.
m400218.どうでしょうか……王子？\n異論は……ありませんか？: What do you think, Prince? Any objections?
m400218.まず、今回の演習では、\n『大討伐ミッション』\nという演習方式をとらせていただ: First, we'll be using a “Grand Annihilation Mission” format for this drill.
m400218.まず大討伐ミッションは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: Its sole objective is simple: defeat the enemies.
m400218.また、大討伐ミッションでは\n出撃コストは時間経過では回復しませんので、\nその: Also, in a Grand Annihilation Mission, deployment costs don't recover over time, so careful team composition and command are essential.
m400218.もちろん、\n我が軍も成長していることは間違いありません。: Of course, our army has grown as well—no doubt about that.
m400218.ライフが0になってもクリアとなりますので、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカウン: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission is cleared, and every enemy you've slain up to that point counts toward your final score.
m400218.互いに仲間であることを再認識し、\n同じ志の許に集ったのだという結束力を高めるこ: By reaffirming our bonds as comrades, strengthening the unity that brings us together under a common purpose, we'll improve coordination and boost our overall strength.
m400218.今はまだ何も起きていませんが、新兵の流入や、\n山賊海賊といった方々の素行や心構: Nothing's happened yet, but we have plenty of concerns: the influx of fresh troops, the lax attitudes of bandits and pirates, and unseen tensions between different species.
m400218.今後、これまでよりも更に激しく\n困難な戦いが私達を待っていることは明白です。: It's clear that even more intense and difficult battles lie ahead of us.
m400218.大討伐ミッションは、\n通常のミッションといくつか異なる点がありますので、\n注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please pay close attention.
m400218.実りのある演習となることを、\n心から願っています。: I truly hope this drill will be a rewarding experience.
m400218.最後に、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: One more thing: defeating enemies won't give you any EXP, gold, or drops, so please keep that in mind.
m400218.様々な種族や生い立ちを持つ者から、\n多種多様なスキルと武具を操る方々が仲間とな: Allies from all sorts of races and backgrounds, wielding a wide variety of skills and weapons, have joined us, making our forces stronger than we ever imagined.
m400218.無法者達への正規訓練の実施や、風紀の維持ならびに\n強化を意図した講習などは常日: We constantly conduct formal training for lawbreakers, maintain discipline, and hold reinforcement lectures, yet some issues are becoming too hard to handle.
m400218.王子……この度は、\n私からの急な申し出に賛同して頂き、\n本当にありがとうござ: Prince… Thank you sincerely for agreeing to my sudden proposal.
m400218.突然ですが王子、\n我が軍を総動員しての大演習の開催を進言します！: Prince, I have a sudden proposal: let's launch a massive training exercise with all our forces!
m400218.魔物たちは、以前に比べその数と強さを増し、\nあまつさえ戦術すら駆使する始末です: The monsters have increased both in number and strength, and they're even employing tactics now.

m400309.――へぶっ……こ、転んじゃいました……。\nじゃなくて大変なんですよー！\n魔法: Ugh... I... I fell... No, it's terrible! A massive number of golems have gone berserk in the Magic City!!
m400309.……うぅっ、ぐすっ、ありがとうございますっ！\nやっぱり王子様が一番頼りになりま: …Sniff, thank you! As always, you're the most reliable, Your Highness!!
m400309.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ方を\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れないでくださいね: Don't forget to put someone with the “Reinforcement Request” skill in your deployment team!
m400309.あっ！ あと敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできま: Ah! Also, defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or drops!
m400309.あまりにも多くの敵が襲撃してくる為、\n大討伐ミッションでは、とにかく\n『多く: Because an overwhelming number of enemies will assault us, the goal of a Grand Hunt Mission is simply to defeat as many foes as possible!
m400309.かつてのゴーレムは魔法都市の守護者でしたが、\n今では魔物の魂に取り憑かれ、\n: The golems were once the city's guardians, but now they're possessed by monster souls and have become spearheads that purge the city's people.
m400309.さらには、急な侵攻に対する出兵ですので、\n出撃コストが時間経過では回復しません: And since this is a sudden deployment against an unexpected invasion, the sortie cost won't recover over time…
m400309.そして今回は、件の自律行動しているゴーレムが、\n都市深部の研究施設で、大量のゴ: And this time, those autonomous golems activated a massive swarm in the deep research facility, marching them toward human settlements—that's the cause, it seems...
m400309.その上、その研究施設では自然に宿る元素の\n研究もしていた為か、ゴーレムに加え、: On top of that, since the facility was also researching the natural elements, elementals have started appearing alongside the golems!
m400309.それから、ライフが０になってもクリアになって、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウントさ: Also, even if your life reaches zero, the mission still clears, and the number of enemies you've slain counts toward your record.
m400309.だから損耗を抑えることよりも、\n少しでも多くの敵を撃破することを優先してくださ: So prioritize taking down enemies over conserving resources!
m400309.で、では出立の前に、今回の戦いについての補足を。\n普段より規模の大きな『大討伐: Now, before we set out, a quick briefing on this battle. It'll be a larger-scale 'Grand Hunt Mission' than usual!!
m400309.もうこうなっては、魔法都市の住人だけでは\nとても対抗できそうになくて……。\n: At this rate, the city's residents alone can't possibly stand up to them... Please, Your Highness, lend us your strength!!
m400309.わっひゃぁああっ！？\n大変大変、大変なんです王子様ぁー！！: Waaah!? This is a disaster, Your Highness!!
m400309.中には取り憑いた魔物の意志が強く反映され、\n自律的に判断、行動するゴーレムもい: Some of them are heavily influenced by the monsters' will, acting autonomously, making this a life-or-death issue even for the city's folk.
m400309.伝説にまで謳われる魔法都市には、\n古来より星の数程のゴーレムがいることは、\n: As you know, Your Highness, the legendary Magic City has been home to countless golems since ancient times.
m400309.激しい戦いになるかと思いますが、\n王子様たちならきっと勝利すると信じています。: It'll be a fierce battle, but I believe you, Prince, will surely win. Now, please issue the Grand Hunt Mission!
m400309.王子様たちの活躍で、魔法都市の生き残りが\n暮らしている地域のゴーレムは一掃され: Thanks to you and the others' efforts, the golems in the surviving districts have been cleared, but many still remain throughout the city.

m400340.――っと、その前に、\n今回の戦いについて、\n私から重要なことを説明させていた: Ah, but before that, let me explain something important about this battle, shall I?
m400340.……え？\nそうなると、また王子が\n女王のフェロモンにやられてしまう……？: ...What? That would mean you'd fall under the queen's pheromones again, Prince...?
m400340.……はい、お察しの通り、\n雄の魔物ばかりです。: …Yes, just as you guessed, they're all male demons.
m400340.……分かりました。\n討伐部隊を結成するのですね。\nでしたら、是非私も連れて行: ...Understood. We'll form an extermination squad. In that case, please take me with you.
m400340.これほど急に、それも爆発的に個体数が増えたという事は、\n新たな女王が現れたとし: The sudden, explosive increase in numbers can only mean a new queen has appeared.
m400340.そして、それをもとに私が抗体を作りましたので\n今回は魔界アリの女王に操られるこ: Using that research, I created an antidote, so this time we won't be controlled by the demon-ant queen. All the men can fight alongside you.
m400340.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しませんので、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者: Because the deployment cost won't recover over time, make sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill—or a Valkyrie—in your sortie team.
m400340.それでは出陣しましょう、王子！\n『大討伐ミッション』スタートです！: Then let's march out, Prince! The “Grand Extermination Mission” starts now!
m400340.それと、あの、王子……。\n実は魔界アリの大軍の中には、\n魔物も混じっていると: Also, um, Prince… Actually, reports say that among the demon-ant horde there are demons mixed in.
m400340.それと、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: And even if you defeat enemies, you won't receive any EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400340.つまり、自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を\n倒せるか: In other words, the focus is on how many foes you can take down, not on minimizing casualties among our own.
m400340.ですので、傷つくことを恐れずに、\n一体でも多くの魔物を倒すことを考えてください: So, don't fear getting hurt—just try to slay as many monsters as you can.
m400340.まず大討伐ミッションとは\n『敵を撃破すること』のみを目的としています。: First, the sole objective is to eliminate enemies.
m400340.また、今回は敵軍の急な侵攻への対処となる為、\nいつものような部隊展開はできませ: Also, this time we have to deal with a sudden enemy invasion, so we can't deploy troops the usual way.
m400340.サイラスさんやバルバストラフさんが、\n以前倒した女王蟻のフェロモンの解析に\n: Sir Cyrus and Barbastraph have successfully analyzed the pheromones of the queen ant we defeated before!
m400340.今回の戦いは、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight is a "Grand Extermination Mission"—the goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400340.以上で、戦いに関する説明は終わりとなります。: That concludes the briefing on the battle.
m400340.以前、王子軍の男性陣が魅了されてしまった大事件が\nありましたが、その時に女王は: There was that big incident when the men of your army were enchanted, and the queen was supposedly slain then... Since then, the demon ants had been quiet...
m400340.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので注意して: Grand Extermination Missions differ from regular missions in several ways, so pay attention.
m400340.敵軍は、魔界アリと雄の魔物の混成軍ですので、\nかなりの苦戦が予想されるとは思い: The enemy forces are a mixed army of demon-ants and male demons, so we're expecting a pretty tough fight, but I'm confident you'll win, Prince!
m400340.更に、今回のミッションにおいては\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまでに: Also, for this mission, you'll clear it even if your life reaches zero; the number of enemies you defeat up to that point will be tallied as your result.
m400340.王国領内に魔界アリの大軍が侵攻を始めています……！: A massive army of demon ants is invading the kingdom's lands...!
m400340.王子！ 私です、テルマです！\n突然、執務室に入ってしまって、すみません。\nで: Prince! It's me, Thelma! Sorry for barging into the office like this, but it's an emergency...!
m400340.錬金術で作った秘薬は、\n魔界アリの硬い甲殻も軟化させる事ができるので、\nきっ: The elixir I brewed can even soften the demon ants' hard exoskeletons, so I think it'll be a great help!
m400340.錬金術の素材を集める為に\n今まで何度も渓谷を訪れているのですが、\nあんな数の: I've been visiting the canyon countless times to gather alchemical ingredients, but I've never seen a swarm like this before...

m400382.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者やワルキューレ等\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を持っ: I recommend including soldiers with the "Request Reinforcements" skill or Valkyries—anyone who can increase deployment costs—in your deployment team.
m400382.さまざまな兵種が増え、戦略に幅が出るのは\n良いことではありますが……それらの影: It's good that we have more unit types and strategic options, but if that causes the troops' morale to drop, it'll be counterproductive.
m400382.そこで今回は、戦力の底上げを図るべく\n王子軍大演習を開催しようかと思っています: So, I'm thinking we should hold a large-scale drill to boost our combat effectiveness.
m400382.それでは、今回の演習の説明に移ります。: Now, let me explain the drill.
m400382.それではこれより『大討伐ミッション』を開始いたします。: With that, the Grand Annihilation Mission will now commence.
m400382.それと敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんの: And keep in mind, defeating enemies won't grant you EXP, gold, or any drops, so be aware of that.
m400382.ただ、そのような事態になっているにもかかわらず\n我が軍は山賊や海賊など、正規の: Yet, despite that, our ranks are swelling with bandits and pirates—people who've never received proper training—and discipline is beginning to slip.
m400382.はっきり申しまして、我が軍はたるんでいると思います！: Frankly, our army has become complacent!
m400382.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the only goal is to "destroy the enemy." That's it.
m400382.また、出撃コストは時間経過で回復いたしません。: Also, deployment costs do not recover over time.
m400382.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain is recorded as your battle result.
m400382.今回の演習では、緊張感を取り戻し更なる力を得ることを\n目的としております。成果: This exercise aims to restore that sense of urgency and gain extra strength. Depending on the results, we might be able to turn future battles to our advantage.
m400382.今回は敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』という演習方式をとらせ: We'll be using a "Grand Annihilation Mission" format, where the sole objective is to defeat the enemy.
m400382.今後、魔物の軍勢との戦いが激化することは明白……。: It's clear that battles against their forces will only intensify from here on out...
m400382.仲間も増えつつある今、全体の力は増しています。\nしかしその余裕からか、軍内の緊: Our numbers are growing, so overall strength is up. But perhaps because of that leeway, the tension within the ranks is fading.
m400382.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションと\nいくつか異なる点がありますのでご注意を: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400382.王子。ここ最近の魔物たちが、以前と比べて強さを\n増している事実、すでにお気付き: Prince, you've surely noticed that the monsters have been getting stronger lately.
m400382.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかを重要視いたします。: We prioritize how many foes you can take down over minimizing your own casualties.

m400427.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士や、\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を備えたワルキュ: I recommend including soldiers with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and Valkyries that increase deployment cost in your lineup.
m400427.このままでは彼らの身が危険です。\n急ぎ彼らを救出致しましょう！: Their lives are in danger if we do nothing. We must rescue them at once!
m400427.この時の為に整えてきた戦力を、\n全て使っての襲撃でしょう。\n此方もしっかりと: They'll throw everything we've prepared at us, so we need solid countermeasures.
m400427.それではこれより、\n『大討伐ミッション』\n開始いたします！: Now then, the “Great Extermination Mission” will begin!
m400427.なにぶん、夜間の急な襲撃故、部隊を用意するのに\n少し手間を要するかと。此度の戦: Since this night-time raid came on short notice, assembling forces will take a bit of effort. Also, deployment costs won't recover over time in this battle, so be careful.
m400427.また吸血鬼化した魔物達の爪牙には麻痺毒があります。\n安易に攻撃を受けすぎては危: The claws and fangs of these vampiric beasts are coated with a paralyzing toxin—attacking recklessly is dangerous.
m400427.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんので: Keep in mind that defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or loot this time.
m400427.バリケードを利用し、極力敵の攻撃を避けるよう\n心掛けるのが上策かと。: Use the barricades and try to avoid enemy attacks as much as possible; that's the best strategy.
m400427.今回は通常のミッションとは異なり、\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This mission differs from the usual ones; it's a “Grand Hunt” mission.
m400427.今宵は雲の多い『闇夜』。月が陰り光が弱まれば、\n吸血鬼達の動きは更に活発になる: Tonight is a cloud-filled “dark night.” They say the vampires grow even more active when the moon wanes and the light grows weak. Prince, please be especially careful.
m400427.以前撃退した『ヴァンパイア公爵』\n彼の者が、配下の吸血鬼の総勢を連れ\n再び領: The Duke of Vampires we defeated before—he's returned with a horde of his vampire minions and is attacking our lands again.
m400427.例えライフが0になってもクリアとなりますので、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカ: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and every enemy you've slain will be tallied as your final score.
m400427.吸血鬼、アンデッドに対して効果的な\n能力を持った方々を編成に加えておくことが必: You'll want to field units that are effective against vampires and the undead.
m400427.大討伐ミッションでは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: In a Grand Hunt, the sole objective is to defeat the enemies.
m400427.王子、出撃の前に幾つか留意事項を\nご説明させて頂きます。: Prince, before we set out, let me go over a few important points.
m400427.王子、此度の襲撃では普段はあまり見かけない\n吸血鬼化した魔物達の姿が見受けられ: Prince, this raid features vampire-transformed monsters we rarely see.
m400427.王子、火急の事態が発生致しました。: Prince, an urgent situation has arisen.
m400427.生き残った住民達はバリケードを設置し、\n屋内へと避難しているようですが……\n: The surviving residents have set up barricades and taken shelter indoors, but… I don't think they can hold out much longer.
m400427.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、いかに多くの\n敵を倒すかが重要なミッションです。\n: Rather than minimizing our own casualties, the key is to slay as many foes as possible. Let's focus on taking down every enemy we can.
m400427.部隊が手薄な地を狙ったのでしょう。\n展開していた部隊では応戦空しく、\n領地は: He must have targeted the area where our forces are thin. Our deployed troops were no match, and the territory fell to them.

m400501.――王子、現状報告を始めるよ。\n端的に言って、緊急事態だ。: ――Prince, I'll start the status report. To put it bluntly, it's an emergency.
m400501.――相手が盗賊なら、\nおたからは分捕っていいよな？: ――If they're just thieves, we can just take their loot, right?
m400501.……あれは、ただの盗賊ではありません。: ……That wasn't just a band of thieves.
m400501.いえ、エオリス、で結構です。\n神の責務を捨て、戦いから逃げた身ですから。: No, Eoris is fine. I've abandoned my divine duties and fled from battle.
m400501.うん。僕もそう判断する。\nだから王子、大討伐ミッションの発令を進言するよ。: Yeah. I agree. So, Prince, I recommend issuing a large-scale extermination mission.
m400501.おそらく、だけどね。\nさらには、生者だけでなく、アンデッドも\nその軍勢に加わ: Probably, yeah. And apparently undead are also joining their ranks, not just the living.
m400501.ぐぬぬぬ、仕方ねぇ。\nつまり敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールドは手に入らねぇって: Grrr, it can't be helped. So even if we defeat the enemies, we won't get any EXP or gold…
m400501.こちらの損害の許容範囲については？: What about our acceptable loss limits?
m400501.それじゃあ王子、全軍に指示を。\nヌンの民を救うため、大討伐ミッションの開始だよ: Then, Prince, give the order to the whole army. Let's start the massive extermination mission to save Nunn's people!
m400501.そんなに謙遜する必要ないと思うけどなぁ……。\nヌンの市民を避難させたり、大活躍: You don't have to be so modest… You helped evacuate Nunn's citizens and made a big impact. Anyway, I'll just call you Eoris.
m400501.だから『ライフが０になってもクリア』となり、\nそれまでの撃破数が記録される、\: So it's fine to think of it as “clear even if life reaches zero,” and the number of defeats up to that point will be recorded.
m400501.だめだよ。\nこれは正式なヌンへの援軍派兵なんだから、\n市民の安全確保が最優先: No, that's not allowed. This is an official reinforcement deployment to Nunn, so protecting the citizens comes first!
m400501.とはいえ、ヌンも戦時下。\n十分な補給は見込めないと考えた方がいいわ。: That said, Nunn is also at war. We shouldn't expect ample supplies.
m400501.ゆえに、今回の戦いでは\n『一体でも多くの敵を倒すこと』で、\n敵戦力を削ぐこと: Therefore, in this battle we should prioritize “killing as many enemies as possible” to whittle down their forces.
m400501.エオリスさん――いや、エオリス様と呼ぶべきかな。\nバスティスたちからの使者とし: Eoris—no, I should probably call you Lord Eoris. He came as a messenger from Bastis, bringing word of Nunn's emergency.
m400501.エオリスさんが伝えてくれた情報によれば、\n蜂起した盗賊団の中に、\n黒く輝く円: According to the info Eoris gave us, among the uprising thieves there was someone bearing a black, shining ring.
m400501.オリュンポス第四層「ヌン」にて、\n盗賊団の一斉蜂起が発生したのが、昨夜のこと。: Last night, on Olympus's fourth layer, Nunn, a full-scale uprising of a band of thieves occurred.
m400501.先日、北の大国で遭遇した\n黒冠の魔物と同じということでしょうか。: Could that be the same as the black-crowned monster we encountered in the northern great nation recently?
m400501.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないから、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワ: Since deployment costs don't recover over time, don't forget to include troops with the “Request Reinforcements” skill or Valkyries in your lineup.
m400501.幸いなことに、ヌンとは友好的な関係にある。\n負傷者の救護にも助力してもらおう。: Fortunately, we have friendly relations with Nunn. They'll help with treating the wounded.
m400501.当初はバスティス、ゼクメトの\n二柱だけで対処可能かと思われたけど――: At first we thought we could handle it with just the two pillars, Bastis and Zekmet—
m400501.敵は盗賊団だけじゃない。\n黒冠の影響下にある敵に、\n発生したアンデッドも加わ: The enemies aren't just the thieves. Those under the black crown's influence also have undead joining them.
m400501.黒冠の影響となれば、\n事態は一刻を争いますね……。: If it's the black crown's influence, time is of the essence…

m400548.――よし、では作戦を説明するかのう。\nティールや、封印区画の地図を。: —Very well, then I'll explain the plan. Here's the map of the sealed district, Tyr.
m400548.――魔法都市の、封印区画？: —The sealed district of the magical city?
m400548.……あながち、間違いとも言い切れぬのう。\n魔法都市に関わる者であれば、\n誰も: …It's not entirely inaccurate. Anyone involved with the magical city knows, though they never speak of it, about a certain sorcerer.
m400548.「王子との戦いを望む」――と。: It says, “I want a battle with the Prince.”
m400548.あくまで、その可能性もあるという話じゃな。: That's just one possibility, at best.
m400548.あとは、その……申し訳ないのですが、\n討伐したゴーレムやクリスタルのパーツは…: Also… I'm sorry, but the parts from the golems and crystals you defeat…
m400548.あの場所に正体不明の存在がいる、というだけで、\n単純に解決できる事態ではないと: The mere fact that an unknown presence is there isn't something we can simply resolve.
m400548.ある禁忌の魔法に手を出し、\n魔法都市の奥深くに封じられた男のことをのう。: He dabbled in a forbidden spell and was sealed deep within the city.
m400548.いずれにせよ、あの区画は厳重に封鎖されており、\n誰も侵入できないようになってい: In any case, the district is heavily sealed off so no one can get in.
m400548.えぇ、すべて魔法都市に返還します。\n貴重な魔法素材でしょうから。: Yeah, they'll all be returned to the magical city. They're valuable magical materials, after all.
m400548.えぇ。現在、表向きには魔力汚染のために\n放棄された区画ということになっています: Yes. Officially it's been abandoned because of magical contamination.
m400548.えぇ。現状、あの区画内から\n出てくる様子はありませんが、\nそれでも放置するわ: Right. Nothing's been coming out of that area so far, but we can't just leave it be.
m400548.この地図の範囲内の全域で、無数のゴーレムと、\n防衛用のクリスタルが徘徊してます: Throughout this map, countless golems and defensive crystals are roaming.
m400548.その封印区画から、一通の手紙が届いたのです。: We received a letter from that sealed district.
m400548.その封印区画内に、多数の防衛機構――\nゴーレムやクリスタルが出現し、\n暴走状: Inside that sealed district, a ton of defense mechanisms—golems and crystals—have appeared and gone berserk.
m400548.その禁忌の魔導士？ のことも気になるけど、\n魔法都市の安全が最優先ですからねー: I'm curious about that forbidden mage too, but the safety of the magical city comes first—so let's just take down as many as we can!
m400548.その魔導士が、今も生きていて、\n王子に戦いを挑んできたと……？: So that sorcerer is still alive and has challenged you to a fight…?
m400548.それでは王子、大討伐ミッション開始です！: Then, Prince, let the massive extermination mission begin!
m400548.それに、気になることもありまして……。: And there's something else that's been bothering me…
m400548.ただ、封印区画に大規模な輜重隊を\n連れて行くのは難しそうです。: That said, sending a large heavy-troop force into the sealed district looks tough.
m400548.なので王子、EXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品は入手できないと考えてください。: So, Prince, don't expect to get any EXP, gold, or drops.
m400548.なるほど。では今回の作戦は、\n一体でも多くの敵を撃破することを目的とした、\n: I see. Then let's make this a large-scale extermination—take down as many enemies as we can.
m400548.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないため、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワ: Because deployment cost doesn't recover over time, units with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and the Valkyries will be key.
m400548.王子様に、こんな危険なことを\nお願いするかどうか、とても悩んだのですが……。: I've been agonizing over whether to ask you, Prince, to take on such a dangerous task…
m400548.素直に受け取るなら、\n封印区画にこっそり住んでる、\n悪の魔法使いが挑戦してき: If we take it at face value, it sounds like “A villainous wizard living secretly in the sealed district has thrown down the gauntlet!”
m400548.魔法都市が全面バックアップしますから、\n「ライフが０になってもクリア」になりま: Since the magical city is giving us full backup, it'll be a “clear even if your life hits zero,” and every enemy you defeat before then will be recorded.
m400548.魔法都市の安全のために、\nこれらの防衛機構は可能な限り破壊する必要があります。: For the safety of the magical city, we need to destroy as many of those defenses as possible.
m400548.魔法都市は王国とも縁の深い関係にあります。\n我々も全力で、調査に協力しましょう: The magical city has deep ties to the kingdom. We'll do everything we can to help with the investigation.

m500105.……え？ 本当に協力してくれるの？ ありがとう！\n王子って噂通り優しいのね。そ: …What? You're really going to help us? Thank you! You're just as kind as the rumors say. Let me tell you what to watch out for when you face Wephar.
m500105.……もう分かってると思うけど、ウェパルは強敵よ。\n王子がどれだけの戦場を経験し: You probably already know Wephar's a tough opponent. I don't know how many battles you've fought, but this one will be the harshest of all.
m500105.ここまで来て逃がすもんですか！\n王子、このままアイツにトドメをさすわよ！: We can't let it get away now! Prince, let's finish this thing once and for all!
m500105.このまま放っておけば、海に生きる者たちは皆、\nウェパルの存在に怯えながら\n過: If we let it run, everyone who lives in the sea will have to spend their lives trembling in fear of Wephar…
m500105.これで、ビエラさんからの依頼は\n達成ということになりますね、王子。\nそれでは: So that means we've fulfilled your request, Prince. Let's head back then.
m500105.ごめん、アンナ。私も一緒に行きたいけど、\nこのまま仲間の水兵達のもとへ向かう事: Sorry, Anna. I'd like to come with you, but I'm going to rejoin the sailors now. I want to reassure everyone as soon as possible ♪
m500105.そうね……あのウェパルから\n海の平和を守ることが出来たんだもの……、\nこれ以: Yeah… we managed to protect the ocean's peace from that Wephar… if we ask for more, we'll just invite punishment ♪
m500105.その魔物は、女人と魚の容姿を上下の半身に備え、\n周囲に水棲の魔物の群れを引き連: It's got a woman's upper half and a fish's lower half, and it's surrounded by a swarm of aquatic beasts… I'm pretty sure it's the sea-monster god, Wephar.
m500105.そんな……あそこまで魔神を\n追い詰めたっていうのに、\nこのまま見過ごすしかな: No… after driving the demon this far, we can't just stand by and watch it slip away…
m500105.だから、仲間たちの訓練やチームの編成をしっかりして、\n万全の状態で戦いに挑まな: That means you need solid training and a well-balanced team—go into the fight fully prepared. Please, Prince… don't overdo it.
m500105.だから、攻撃することばかりに気を取られて\n防御をおろそかにしたら、命取りになる: So if you get too caught up in attacking and neglect defense, you'll be putting your life at risk. Got it? Remember that, Prince.
m500105.だからお願い、王子。\nあなたの力を貸して欲しいの。: So please, Prince. I need your help.
m500105.って、今はそれどころじゃなかったわ。\n実は海岸に強力な魔物が現れたのよ！: …but that's the last thing on my mind right now. A powerful monster just showed up on the coast!
m500105.ふふ……ええ、愉しみにしてていいわ。\n王子が望むこと、何でもしてあげるから♪\: Heh… yeah, look forward to it. I'll do anything you wish, Prince ♪. Now I'm off. Thank you so much!
m500105.ウェパルは相手の傷口を腐らせる能力を備えて\nいるから、ヤツがいる時に傷を負うと: Wephar can rot wounds, so any injury you take while it's around will deal far more damage than usual. Keep that in mind.
m500105.ビエラさん、伝説の魔神をこの海から\n退けただけでも、私達にとっては\n奇跡のよ: Viera, just driving the legendary demon god out of this sea is a miracle for us, isn't it?
m500105.待つのだ、ビエラ！\nウェパルは魔界へと還っていくようじゃ……、\n後を追えば、: Hold on, Viera! Wephar's heading back to the Demon Realm… If we follow, you won't come out of that alive.
m500105.想像がつかない……？ う～ん、そうねぇ……。\nウェパルがいる間は、フィールド効: Can't picture it? Well… think of it like this: as long as Wephar's on the field, the damage you receive is doubled.
m500105.王子、ウェパルが撤退していきます！\nどうやら海底へ逃げようとしているみたいです: Prince, Wephar's retreating! It looks like it's trying to flee down to the ocean floor!
m500105.王子、力を貸してくれてありがとう。\nあなたに頼んで、本当によかったわ。\nいつ: Prince, thanks for lending your strength. I'm really glad I asked you. One day I'll return the favor, okay?
m500105.私の名前はビエラ。水兵よ。\nあなたが噂の王子ね……？\nふ～ん、思ったよりいい: My name's Viera, a sailor. You must be the Prince everyone's been talking about…? Huh, you're better looking than I expected♪
m500105.魔神ウェパルから、\n攻撃の意思を感じなくなったわ……。\nこれって……私たちの: Wephar's stopped showing any intent to attack… Does that mean… we've won?

m500132.――え？ \n実の父親を討つことになっても平気なのか……？:
—What?
Even if I have to slay my own father, can I still do it...?
m500132.…………いや、どうやら\nとどめは刺せなかったみたい……。: ………No, it seems I couldn't land the finishing blow…
m500132.…………どうやら、聞くまでもなかったみたいね。\n本当にありがとう、王子！:
………It looks like I didn't even need to ask.
Thank you so much, Prince!
m500132.……ごめん。\nあてが酒呑童子に力を奪われなければ\nこんな事にはなってなかった: …I'm sorry. If my father hadn't had his power stolen by Shuten-dōji, this wouldn't have happened...
m500132.……ん？ 誰かと思えば\n茨木童子じゃねーかッ！\nいい加減戻ってくる気になった: …Hm? If it's someone I know, it's Ibaraki-dōji! So you finally decided to come back!!
m500132.あてが力を奪われたばっかりに\n……本当にごめんなさい。: Having just had my power taken away… I'm truly sorry.
m500132.ええ。あてに迷いはないわ。\n勿論、何も感じないと言えば嘘になるけど、\n……そ:
Yes. There's no doubt about it.
Of course, saying I feel nothing would be a lie, but…
…still, I want freedom.
m500132.さっき話したように、酒呑童子が従える鬼の大群が\n東の国の都を占拠している現状を: As I mentioned, with Shuten-dōji's demon horde occupying the Eastern capital, countless demons are surely lying in wait…
m500132.そうですね！\nこれからは、都に笑顔を取り戻す為に頑張りましょう。\n王子、忙し: Indeed! From now on, let's work hard to bring smiles back to the city. Prince, looks like you'll be busy!
m500132.そうね、あてらは勝利した……それは確かだわ。\nだから言わせて、王子。力を貸して: That's right, you won… that's certain. So let me say, Prince, thank you for lending me your strength. At last, the capital is freed from the demons' grasp.
m500132.それじゃあ出発の前に注意すべきことを伝えておくわ。: Then, before we set out, let me tell you what to watch out for.
m500132.それでは皆さん、帰還しましょう。\n王子、お疲れ様でした！: Then everyone, let's return. Prince, thank you for your efforts!
m500132.それでも、ヤツが相当な傷を負ったのは間違いない……。\nしばらくの間は、指一本も: Even so, there's no doubt he took a serious wound… He'll be unable to move a finger for a while.
m500132.それと、酒呑童子の怪力にはくれぐれも気を付けて。: And be especially careful of Shuten-dōji's brute strength.
m500132.それに、これ以上、人間が傷つくのを見たくないから……。\nあては人と鬼が手を取り:
And I don't want to see any more humans get hurt…
You taught me that humans and demons can work together, Prince.
So I can no longer turn a blind eye to Shuten-dōji's atrocities.
m500132.だから、そんな鬼達の群に備えて、\n騎兵のような素早く兵を展開できる力を持つ者た: So, to prepare for those hordes, I think we should include units that can deploy quickly like cavalry in our formation.
m500132.だから、王子……。今回の戦いに出向く前には、\n編成を見直して、しっかりと準備を: Therefore, Prince… before you head into battle, you need to revise your lineup and be properly prepared.
m500132.だから今は前を向き、\n酒呑童子を倒すことだけに集中しましょう。: So let's look ahead and focus only on defeating the Wine Cellar Boy.
m500132.どうやら父上が……ううん、酒呑童子が、\n東の国の都を攻め落としたみたいなの。: It seems my father... no, Shuten-dōji, has taken the capital of the Eastern Kingdom.
m500132.はん、おもしれェッ！\nやれるもんならやってみなァッ！！: Ha, how fun! If you think you can do it, try it!
m500132.ひどすぎる……あの美しかった都を……\n無数の鬼たちが埋め尽くしているなんて……: This is terrible… that beautiful capital… now buried under endless demons…
m500132.力を完全に取り戻した酒呑童子に呼応するように、\nその許へと集った手下たちの大群: With Shuten-dōji fully restored, a massive horde of his minions gathered there, turning the city into a demon capital overnight.
m500132.勝手なお願いなのは分かってる。\n……だけど、お願い！\n酒呑童子を倒す為に、力: I know it's a selfish request… but please! I need your help to defeat Shuten-dōji!
m500132.王子、あての背中はあなたに預けるからね。: Prince, I'll entrust my back to you.
m500132.王子、急に呼び出してごめんね。\nただ、どうしても王子に\n伝えておかなきゃいけ:
Prince, I'm sorry for calling you out like this.
But there's something I absolutely have to tell you...
m500132.血の繋がりのせいかな……。\nあてには分かるんだ。: Maybe it's because of our blood ties… I can tell by looking at you.
m500132.謝らないでください！\n鬼刃姫さんが悪いわけではありません。: Don't apologize! It's not Kibahime's fault.
m500132.酒呑童子は、特殊な力を使うでもなく、\nその怪力だけで無数の鬼を従えるようになっ: Shuten-dōji doesn't use any special abilities; he commands countless demons purely with his raw power… Ordinary soldiers will struggle to withstand his attacks.
m500132.馬鹿を言わないで！ \nあてはもう父上の所には戻ったりしない……そうよ！\nあな: Don't be ridiculous! I won't go back to my father's side… that's right! I'll defeat you and finally be free!

m500551.――はぁ、とうとうゲネプロの日が……。: ――Sigh. The day of the dress rehearsal has finally arrived…….
m500551.――ふぇ？ 帝国史を演劇に？: ――Feh? Turn Imperial history into a play?
m500551.――激闘！ 帝国ボスラッシュ！ でしたか。\n最初に聞いた時は耳を疑ったものです: ――"Fierce Battle! Imperial Boss Rush!" was it? I nearly disbelieved my ears when I first heard it.
m500551.――白の帝国史は、常に戦いの中にあった。: ――The history of the White Empire has always been one of war.
m500551.――荒れ狂う猛竜、かつて魔王の配下として\n恐怖を振りまき、此度帝国が都市を蹂躙:
――The raging dragon, once a minion of the Demon King,
who spread terror and trampled the Empire's cities: the Dragon General Croco.
m500551.……振り返ってみると、色々なことがありましたね。: ……Looking back, we've been through quite a lot.
m500551.「観客にマジでガチのバトルを見せます！」とか、\nトットンさんじゃないと出てこな: "We're going to show the audience a real, no-holds-barred battle!" That's the kind of idea only Totton would come up with.
m500551.あ、いえ、私はサポート役にということで、\nディアナ様に呼ばれただけですよ？: Ah, no, I'm just here in a support capacity. Lady Diana simply requested my assistance.
m500551.ある夜、ひとりの戦士が剣をとり、\n幾重にも連なる皇帝の座についた。:
One night, a warrior took up his sword,
and ascended to the throne of emperors, stacked one upon another.
m500551.いかにして、白の帝国はこの強敵を退けたのか。: How did the White Empire repel these mighty foes?
m500551.いずれも避けられない戦いでした。\nそしてきっと、これからも。:
They were all battles that could not be avoided.
And surely, they will be in the future, too.
m500551.いつか、平和な時代は来るのでしょうか？: Will there ever come a time of peace?
m500551.いやー、来ないんじゃないですか？: Oh, I don't think so, do you?
m500551.うぇえええええええー！？\nわ、わわ、私がやるんですかー！？: W-WHAT?! I'm the one doing it?!
m500551.これは、白の帝国と、冥界との戦いを描く史実。: This is the true history of the war between the White Empire and the Underworld.
m500551.これは、白の皇帝と勇猛なる帝国軍、\nそして臣民なるあなたの物語である――:
This is the story of the White Emperor, the valiant Imperial Army,
and you, our loyal subjects――
m500551.これまでに帝国軍が戦ってきた強敵、\nその戦いを、実際に帝国軍人の模擬戦で再現す: Recreating the fights the Imperial Army has waged against powerful foes in the past, using actual Imperial soldiers in a mock battle. It certainly suits the nature of our people.
m500551.しかし、やはりトットンに任せて正解だったな。\nまさかこんな突拍子もない案を出し: However, it was definitely the right call to entrust this to Totton. I never expected such an outlandish proposal to come from her.
m500551.そのためにも――:
Feh! W-what's going on?!
Why are you picking me up?!
m500551.では、そろそろ定刻です。\n皆さん配置よろしくお願いします！: Well, it's about time. Everyone, please take your positions!
m500551.ど、どうしてこうなったー！？: How did things end up like this?!
m500551.どこまでも優しく、されど決して人類とは相容れぬ、\n冥界を収めし大いなる神――ハ:
Endlessly gentle, yet utterly incompatible with humanity,
the great god who holds the Underworld in his grasp: Hades.
m500551.はい。より正確には、\n名作揃いの過去の帝国史劇に連なる、\n現皇帝陛下の物語を: Yes. More precisely, we're looking to write a new story about His Majesty the current Emperor, one that follows in the footsteps of the classic Imperial historical dramas of the past.
m500551.はーい、パーティの準備はできてますよー！:
For the battles to come, and for the people of the White Empire,
please make the most of tonight to rest and recover.
m500551.ふぇっ、な、なんです！？\nなんで抱き上げられてるんですか！？: Totton has accomplished a great feat, so she certainly deserves a reward, don't you think?
m500551.ふむふむ、さぽーとやく……。\nあれ、じゃあメインで音楽と物語を綴るのは\nいっ: Mm-hmm, a support role……. Wait, then who is going to be the main one handling the music and the story?
m500551.ほえぇ……。\nそれでホルミースさんにお声がかかったと。: Huh……. So that's why you were called in, Holmes.
m500551.わっ、すごい、\n私と同じ名前の吟遊詩人さんがいたんですね。: Wha— wow, there must be a bard with the same name as me!
m500551.わっ、大丈夫ですかトットンさん？\n医務室のベッド使います？:
Oh! Are you alright, Totton?
Should we use the bed in the infirmary?
m500551.トットン、ここ最近のお前の活躍は目覚ましい。\n帝国軍の中でも、トットンの演奏か: Totton, your recent performance has been remarkable. There are many voices within the Imperial Army saying they've gained an incredible surge of energy from your playing.
m500551.トットン、見事に大役を成し遂げたご褒美が必要ですわね？: Yaaay! Party preparations are all set!
m500551.今宵、帝国に襲いかかりし三度の危機について語ろう。: Tonight, let us speak of the three crises that beset the Empire.
m500551.偉大なるヴィラヘルムに連なる白の帝国。\n血に塗れ、しかし栄光の道を歩み続けた我: The White Empire, bound to the great Wilhelm. Our homeland, stained with blood, yet ever walking the path of glory.
m500551.初めての大役、見事に成し遂げたな。\n立派だったぞ、トットン。:
You've pulled off your first major task with flying colors.
Well done, Totton.
m500551.危機が訪れた時、それをどう乗り越えるのか。\nそのための備えと覚悟こそが、\n白: So we should just keep doing our best, then.
m500551.国威発揚の面もあるが、\n目的としては、帝国軍の直近の戦果を、\n民衆に正しく伝: While boosting national prestige is part of it, the main goal is to accurately convey the Empire's recent military victories to the people.
m500551.帝国音楽隊の所属で、市民に大人気で、\n王国でも名が売れているトットンさんを、\: Totton, who is a member of the Imperial Band, hugely popular with the citizens, and already famous in the Kingdom—there's no reason we wouldn't cast you right here and now.
m500551.平和とは、無理をして維持をするものではありません。:
Peace is not something to be forced into existence.
When a crisis strikes, how we overcome it is what matters.
The preparation and resolve to face it head-on
are the very things that have kept the White Empire standing this long.
m500551.意見がすれ違えば、衝突するものです。\nそれはつまり、この世界にはそれだけ多くの:
When opinions clash, conflict is inevitable.
It simply means this world is home to so many people,
each of them thinking all sorts of different things.
m500551.本番直前におこなう、\n全編通しで行う最終リハーサル、みたいなものですね。\nつ: It's the final rehearsal held just before the official performance, where we run through the entire piece from start to finish. Essentially, it's almost the real thing.
m500551.王国での合同演奏会も見事にやり遂げた上、\n打楽器をメインに据えた新しい音楽の潮: I've heard that not only did you pull off the joint concert in the Kingdom perfectly, but you're even creating a new musical trend centered around percussion instruments.
m500551.現皇帝の活躍を、\n帝国臣民に知らしめる、大切な機会です。\n期待していますよ、: This is a crucial opportunity to make the Imperial subjects aware of the current Emperor's achievements. I look forward to seeing what you do, Totton.
m500551.皇帝陛下の活躍は大衆演劇でも好まれますが、\n昨今流行っているのは、\nどれも誇: His Majesty's exploits are always popular in public theater, but the recent trends are all so exaggerated that they don't even resemble the original events.
m500551.美しき庭園に眠りし、\nかつて世界の滅びすら招かんとした女神、ペルセフォネ。:
The goddess who sleeps in the beautiful garden,
who once sought to bring about the end of the world: Persephone.
m500551.（ここだー！ 響け！ 私のドラムーッ！！）: (Here it comes! Ring out! My drama!!)

m900542.――で、あの運河遺跡の近くに、\nこの子がいたわけなんですけど……。: ――So, this child was found near the canal ruins, but...
m900542.――実際に、その戦いを見た者はいない、のよね。: ――no one has actually seen it in battle, have they?
m900542.……この子にとっての、\n最高の終わりに違いない、ですわね。:
...For this child,
that must surely be the best possible ending.
m900542.……どうみても尋常な馬じゃない。\nむしろ神獣に近い気配を感じる。:
...It doesn't look like an ordinary horse at all.
If anything, I sense an aura closer to that of a divine beast.
m900542.……なるほど。\nそれでポセイオスは、ヒッポカムポスを\n遺跡に封印したのですね:
...I see.
So Poseidon sealed Hippocampus
in the ruins.
m900542.……なんと、なんと見事な散り様か。\nそれがし、それがしは……ッ。: ……What a… what a magnificent way to go. I… I…
m900542.……何か、救ってやる手段は？: ...Is there any way to save it?
m900542.あ、あの、王子は神獣討伐でお疲れのはずでは――: Um, the Prince should be exhausted from slaying the divine beast, though—
m900542.あっ、でしたらキャリーさん、\nぜひ私を後ろに乗せていってくださいな。: Oh, if that's the case, Ms. Carrie, please let me ride in the back.
m900542.あっ、行ってしまいました……。\nなんだか、ユリクセスさんらしくないですね？: Oh, they're already gone…… It doesn't really seem like Ulyxes, does it?
m900542.あのポセイオスですら、\n封じることでしか止められなかったんだ。\n今の僕らにで:
Even Poseidon himself
could only stop it by sealing it away.
The only thing we can do now is――
m900542.あの子は……すでに役目を終えた神獣ですの。: That little one is... a divine beast that has already finished its duty.
m900542.あら、どうしたのアンブローズ。\n新しい遊び？ 新種の模擬戦かしら？:
Oh my, what's the matter, Ambrose?
A new game? A new kind of sparring match?
m900542.いえ、どこかから\n馬のいななきが聞こえたような……。: No, I could have sworn I heard a horse neighing from somewhere…
m900542.いえ、封印されていたのだから\nさすがにそれはないかと……。: No, since it was sealed away, I doubt that's the case…
m900542.えぇ。海神による封印という手段を取れない以上、\nもはや、私たちの手で\n終わら:
Yes. Since we cannot employ the Sea God's seal,
there is nothing left for us to do
but put it out of its misery ourselves.
m900542.えぇ。穏やかな夢のなかで、\n輝かしい戦場の思い出とともに眠らせようと。:
Yes. To let it sleep peacefully in gentle dreams,
along with its glorious memories of the battlefield.
m900542.けれど、これまで数多くの武勲を打ち立てた\n神獣の最期が、自我を失って暴れまわり:
But for a divine beast that has achieved so many feats of valor,
its end being a legend of it rampaging without self-awareness
and being slain is far too pitiful...
m900542.けれど、その封印が解けてしまったのなら、\n娘である私が父に代わって\nあの子の:
But if that seal has been broken,
then as his daughter, I must take my father's place
and bring that little one's story to an end.
m900542.こいつの言葉が分かるのか！？: You can understand what it's saying?!
m900542.この子に乗るときは、王子の称号を\n「海神軍馬の騎手」にすればいいからね。: When the Prince rides this one, let's make his title “Rider of the Sea God's Warhorse.”
m900542.これが模擬戦に見えるなら\n魔女廃業した方がいいですよぉ！？:
If you think this looks like a sparring match,
maybe you should quit being a witch!
m900542.それじゃあ王子、さっそく遠乗りでもいかがです？\nこの子も走りたがっているでしょ: Then how about the Prince takes a little ride right away? This one seems eager to run, too!
m900542.それは、そうなのですけれど……。\nでも、あの子は……。:
I know, I know...
But that little one is...
m900542.それゆえに、封印から解き放たれたあの子は、\n本能のままに暴れ、あらゆるものを\:
That is why, once freed from the seal, that child
can only rampage on instinct,
destroying everything in its path.
m900542.それを聞いた途端に、\n全部自分ひとりで解決しないと――なんて言って、\nメシナ:
The moment she heard that,
she insisted on handling it all by herself, and I'm currently trying to stop her from running off.
m900542.ただ、そういった物語は数多あれど――: However, no matter how many such stories there are...
m900542.だって、だってあの子はぁ……。\n私が止めてあげないと……。:
But, but that little one is...
I have to stop it...
m900542.でも、こんな危険な戦いに、\n皆さんを巻き込むわけには……。:
But I cannot possibly drag everyone into
such a dangerous battle...
m900542.でも、今のあなたには\n頼るべき仲間がいるんですよぅ？: But now, you have companions you can rely on, you know?
m900542.でも確かに、あの子の魔力を感じます。\nもしかしたら力の残滓が形になったのかもし: But I can definitely feel the child's magical power. Perhaps it's a remnant of its strength taking form.
m900542.とにかく、一度落ち着け。\n何か事情があるのは分かった。\nそれでも、神獣が暴れ:
Anyway, calm down for a moment.
I understand there's a reason.
But if a divine beast is rampaging, reporting it to the Prince should come first.
m900542.なるほど、メシナさんのお父上――\nつまり亜神ポセイオスの軍馬たる、\n神獣ヒッ:
I see. So Meshina's father,
meaning the subservient deity Poseidon's warhorse,
the divine beast Hippocampus, is rampaging...
m900542.はぁ……本当に困ったお姫様ね。\nかつてのあなたなら、それで良かったかもしれない:
Haa... You really are a troublesome princess.
Perhaps that would have been acceptable in the past.
m900542.ふふっ、あの方は軍を率いる将なのでしょう？: Hehe, surely he's a general who leads an army?
m900542.まぁ、出会って早々に\n王子に背中を許したんだ。\n最初からそのつもりだったんだ: Well, it trusted the Prince with its back right after they met. It must have been like that from the start.
m900542.もしかしたら、ヒッポカムポスの魔力にあてられて、\n野生の馬が迷い込んでいるのか: Perhaps a wild horse got lost, drawn in by Hippocampus's magical power.
m900542.もしかして、ヒッポカムポスの隠し子……？: Could it be... an illegitimate child of Hippocampus?
m900542.キャリー、僕らは一緒に\n周辺を探ってから戻るとしよう。: Carrie, let's search the area together before we head back.
m900542.キャリーさん？ 何か気になることでも？: Ms. Carrie? Is something bothering you?
m900542.ヌゥン！\n心配めされるな、ユリクセス殿！:
Nnuun!
Do not worry, Lord Ulyxes!
m900542.ヒッポカムポス、あなたの物語は、\n父の最上の友であったと、\n吟遊詩人たちに伝: Hippocampus, I'll make sure the bards know that you were my father's dearest companion.
m900542.ヒッポカムポスといえば、\nポセイオスの乗騎として、\nその偉大さはよく語られて:
Hippocampus is well known as Poseidon's mount,
and its greatness is often spoken of.
m900542.ヒッポカムポスは偉大なる戦士の馬！\n当代の英雄と、その仲間たちと、\n死力を尽:
Hippocampus is the horse of a great warrior!
To fight with all its might against the heroes of the age and their companions,
and to fall in battle, is the greatest honor!
m900542.世界を蹂躙し、滅ぼす巨悪ではなく、\n英雄との手合わせの果てに死んだのだと、\n:
To tell the ages that it did not die as a giant evil
that trampled and destroyed the world,
but that it perished in a duel with heroes――
m900542.偉大なる海神の乗騎、その物語を終わらせるなら、\n海神の認めた英雄を連れて行くべ:
If we are to bring an end to the story of the Sea God's mount,
should we not bring along the hero recognized by the Sea God?
m900542.先程、神獣の封印が解けて、\n運河遺跡で大暴れしていると報告があったんです。:
We just received a report that the seal on a divine beast has been broken,
and it's causing havoc at the Canal Ruins.
m900542.我が父、ポセイオスの軍馬なんですの！: It is my father, Poseidon's warhorse!
m900542.戦で負った傷は癒えても、\n失われた自我の苦しみは消えないのです。:
The wounds from battle may heal,
but the anguish of its lost self-awareness remains.
m900542.最期の瞬間、確かに瞳に\nかつての輝きが戻っていました。: In its final moments, I could truly see the former radiance return to its eyes.
m900542.父がいつも言っていましたの。\n馬とは移動手段ではない。\n戦場においては友と言: Father used to say that horses aren't just a means of transportation. On the battlefield, they're closer to friends.
m900542.王子、皆さん、本当にありがとうございました。: Prince, everyone, thank you so much.
m900542.王子に懐いているみたいだし、\nときどき、戦場に連れて行ってあげると良いと思う。: It seems to have taken a liking to the Prince. I think it would be good to take it to the battlefield with us from time to time.
m900542.神獣ヒッポカムポスは勇敢なる海神の乗騎。\n誕生からその最期まで、\n輝かしい武:
The divine beast Hippocampus is the steed of the valiant Sea God.
I must ensure that its story, from its birth to its final breath,
is remembered alongside its glorious deeds.
m900542.神獣ヒッポカムポス！\nすべての海を駈けた最速の軍馬よ！:
Divine beast Hippocampus!
The fastest warhorse to have galloped across all the seas!
m900542.脚を踏み外して運河に落ちたりしたら可哀想だろう？\n――王子、そういうわけだ。\: Wouldn't it be a shame if it slipped and fell into the canal? ……That's the situation, Prince. I'm leaving the cleanup entirely to you!
m900542.言葉まではわからないけど、何となく……？: I can't understand the words exactly, but I get the feeling…
m900542.誇り高き海神の軍馬として、\nその生を終えられたのだと信じましょう。: Let us believe that it ended its life with the pride of the Sea God's warhorse.
m900542.遅くならないうちに戻ってきてくださいねー！？: Please don't be too late coming back, okay!?
m900542.遥かな古代の戦いで負った傷、\nそれが原因でヒッポカムポスは\n完全に自我を失い:
The wounds it sustained in an ancient battle long ago
were the cause. Hippocampus
completely lost its self-awareness and went berserk.
m900542.随分とおとなしい馬だね。\nヒッポカムポスが自我を保っていたときには、\nこんな: What a gentle horse, isn't it? When Hippocampus still retained its self-awareness, it may have been just like this.
m900542.離してくださいな！\n私は行かないといけないのですわー！:
Let me go!
I have to go!

m900580.――森の番人、神獣フンババですか……。: ――The forest guardian, the divine beast Humbaba……
m900580.……その過程で関係ない人間たちが、\n巻き添えを食らうわけですか。:
……So unrelated people will get caught in the crossfire
during that process, you mean.
m900580.……とにかく、フンババは\n悪意に満ちた神獣だということです。: ……In short, Humbaba is a divine beast filled with malice.
m900580.……フンババの魔力を感じるわね。\nあれの置き土産、なのかしら。: ...I can sense Humbaba's magic in it. Is this a parting gift from it?
m900580.……森の番人って呼ばれるくらいですから、\nもっとカッコよくて高潔な神獣を想像し: ...Given that it's called the Guardian of the Forest, I was imagining a more dignified and noble divine beast...
m900580.……現代にはそんなふうに伝わっているんですか？: ……Is that how it's passed down in modern times?
m900580.あ、あれが神獣フンババ……！: Ah, so that's the divine beast Humbaba……!
m900580.あっ、そうだ。上手くいけば、\nフンババからギルガメッシュの手がかりを\n得るこ:
Oh, that's right. If everything goes well,
we might be able to get a clue about Gilgamesh
from Humbaba.
m900580.あの……どうしてフンババの話になると、\nそんな困ったような顔をするんですか……:
Um…… why do you both look so troubled
when Humbaba is mentioned……?
m900580.あれがそんなことをするとは思えませんが……。\nとりあえず、持って帰って調べまし: I doubt it would do something like that... but let's take it back and investigate.
m900580.あれは、そうねぇ……。\nどうしようもなかったから、\nとりあえず倒したみたいな:
Well, that's hard to say…….
It was a desperate situation, so
they probably just knocked it out, I suppose?
m900580.あれは色々と強敵だから、油断せずに行きましょう。: It's a powerful foe in many ways, so let's not let our guard down.
m900580.あー……それはたぶん、\nフンババが持っていた英雄王への異常な憎しみでしょうね。:
Ah... that is probably
Humbaba's abnormal hatred for the Hero King.
m900580.ええ、物質界に屍の山がいくつもできるでしょうね。: Yes. Several mountains of corpses will likely pile up in the material world.
m900580.おお、さすが王子様。\n言われるまでもないって感じですね。:
Oh, just like the Prince.
You don't need to be told, do you?
m900580.かの神獣はここ千年の間眠りについていたのですが、\n先日目を覚まし、森の奥で暴れ:
That divine beast has been sleeping for the past thousand years,
but it recently awakened and appears to be rampaging deep in the forest.
m900580.けれど、その厄介な神獣を追い詰めているのも事実よ。: But the fact remains that we are driving that troublesome divine beast into a corner.
m900580.ここから先は注意してください。\nフンババはこちらの状態に合わせて、\n強化形態:
Please be careful from here on.
Humbaba will shift into an enhanced form
depending on our current status.
m900580.こちらの状態に合わせて、って……どういうことですか？: Depending on our status? What does that mean?
m900580.さて、暴れ回る困った神獣を、\n退治しに向かいましょうか。: Now then, let's go deal with that troublesome divine beast and put an end to its rampage.
m900580.せ、制御に失敗した神獣というのは……？: A divine beast that failed to be controlled? What does that mean……?
m900580.そうして楽しんだ後は、犠牲者の肉を噛み砕いて、\n自分と動物たちで分け合って食べ: After enjoying the torment, it gnaws on the flesh of its victims and shares it with the animals……
m900580.そうですね……今はそれで良しとしましょうか。: Yes... let's consider it a success for now.
m900580.そして、フンババはその対象をなにがあっても殺す。\n森から逃げても、あれはどこま: And no matter what, Humbaba will kill that target. Even if they flee the forest, it will chase them to the ends of the earth.
m900580.その当時になにがあったのか気になりますが、\nそれよりも今は神獣フンババです。:
I'm curious about what happened back then,
but for now, we have the divine beast Humbaba to deal with.
m900580.その武器を使いたいときは、\n称号を【原初森林の番人】にすればいいからね！: When you want to use those weapons, just change your title to 【Guardian of the Primordial Forest】!
m900580.それが、武器になってなお残ってるみたいな……。: It seems that hatred persists, even now that it has become a weapon.
m900580.それで、どうしてあれが\n王子に力を与えようとしたのかだけど……。:
As for why it tried to grant that power
to the Prince...
m900580.それもあるけど……。\nギルガメッシュが現れたのが原因でしょうね。: That's part of it…… But the reason is Gilgamesh's appearance.
m900580.ただ殺すだけならいいんですが、\nフンババは相手を徹底的に嬲り、蹂躙してきます。: If it were just killing them, that would be one thing, but Humbaba toils and tramples its opponents thoroughly.
m900580.だから千年戦争当時に倒す必要があったんですよね。: That is precisely why it needed to be defeated during the Millennium War.
m900580.ですから……えーと、なんだ……？\n王子様の理想のために、使い倒してやりましょう:
So... um, what was it...?
Let's use it to the fullest for the sake of your ideals...?
m900580.では、さっそく向かいましょうか。\nフンババは「神の威光」を持っていますから、\:
Then let's head out right away.
Humbaba possesses the "Radiance of the Divine,"
so please be careful when forming your unit.
m900580.では、王国に帰還しましょうか。\nお疲れ様でした、王子！: Then, let's return to the kingdom. Good work, Prince!
m900580.というか作戦上のどうしようもない都合で、\n森を進軍することになったら、\n運悪: Well, it was just a tactical necessity. We had to march through the forest, and unfortunately, we ran into Humbaba.
m900580.ところでだけど、王子さま。\nこれ、渡してあげるね。: By the way, Prince. Here, take this.
m900580.とりあえず、フンババによる被害を未然に食い止め、\nその力も手に入れられて、一件: For now, we've managed to prevent any damage from Humbaba and acquired its power, so I'd say that's a wrap.
m900580.なるほど、コストを溜めすぎても駄目。\n減らしすぎても駄目なようですね。:
I see. So it's no good to hoard too much cost.
And it's no good to let it drop too low, either.
m900580.なんか、ショックだね。\nかの神獣みたいに私も森を守るんだ、とか、\nそういうこ: It's a bit of a letdown. I used to think about how I'd protect the forest just like that divine beast...
m900580.なんか、森の番人のイメージとは違うね。\nもっと穏やかな神獣だと思ってたけど。: It doesn't really fit the image of a forest guardian, does it? I thought divine beasts were supposed to be more gentle.
m900580.なんでしょうね、この……。\n装備を見ているだけでひしひしと伝わってくる、\n尋:
What is this...?
Just looking at the equipment, I can feel it.
An unusual, intense hostility...
m900580.にしても、随分と怒ってますね。\nあの人に負けたのを相当根に持ってるってことでし: Still, it's quite angry. Does it hold a deep grudge against losing to that person?
m900580.ほら、なんだか顔見知りっていうか、\n戦った過去があるみたいですし……！:
Look, they seem to know each other,
and they have a shared combat history……!
m900580.ま、まぁ、力は力ですよ！\nそれを得た経緯とか、込められた想いとかがアレでも、\:
W-Well, power is power!
No matter how it was obtained, or what feelings were poured into it,
how it is used is entirely up to you, Prince!
m900580.まぁ、神獣フンババがどういう存在なのかは、\n実際に見てもらったほうが早いわね。:
Well, the best way to understand what the divine beast Humbaba
really is, is to see it for yourselves.
m900580.まぁまぁ、とりあえずフンババを倒して、\n今後起こり得た被害は食い止められたわけ: Well, we defeated Humbaba, so we've prevented any potential future damage.
m900580.めちゃくちゃ生き汚い感じの散り様だったけどね。: It did go out with a pretty ugly display of tenacity, though.
m900580.もうすでに森の動物たちは怪我しちゃってるみたいだし、\n王子さまには、フンババを:
The animals in the forest are already getting hurt,
so we need the Prince to stop Humbaba……!
m900580.もしかすると王子に力を与えたのは、妥協だったのかもね。: Perhaps granting the Prince that power was just a compromise.
m900580.わたしたちにはそのように言い伝えられているんですが、\nもしかして、違うんですか:
That's what we've been told, but…
could it be different in reality……?
m900580.フンババが余力を測る指標としているものは、\n部隊を展開するためのリソース……つ:
The metric Humbaba uses to gauge our remaining strength
is the resource used to deploy units…… in other words, our cost.
m900580.フンババが倒れるときにね、すっごく嫌そうに、\nこれを王子さまに渡してほしいって: When Humbaba fell, it looked really reluctant, but it asked me to pass this to you.
m900580.フンババが王子を認めて、\n力を貸し与えてくれたのでしょうか？: Perhaps Humbaba acknowledged the Prince and lent him its power?
m900580.フンババというと、千年戦争当時に英雄王に倒され、\nその軍門に下った神獣ですね。:
Humbaba is the divine beast that was defeated by the Hero King
during the Millennium War and subsequently
submitted to his command, if I recall correctly.
m900580.フンババとは、英雄王と一緒に戦ったってことなのかな。\n二人はなんだか、とっても:
So Humbaba fought alongside the Hero King, then.
They seem to have quite a history together.
m900580.フンババの実態は、やたら強いだけの怪物ですからね。: In reality, Humbaba is just a monster that happens to be incredibly strong.
m900580.フンババの行動原理はただひとつ。: Humbaba operates on a single principle.
m900580.フンババは常に私たちを監視して、\nどれくら余力があるかを測っているの。:
Humbaba is constantly watching us,
gaging how much strength we have left.
m900580.伝承では、英雄王に倒されたフンババは、\n軍門に下ったとされていますが……。: According to legend, Humbaba was defeated by the Hero King and surrendered to his army, but……
m900580.余力がありすぎれば、\nこちらの優勢を崩すために全力以上の力を発揮する。:
If we have too much left,
it will unleash more than its full power to break our advantage.
m900580.侵入者にどんな事情があろうが関係ない。\n一歩でも入れば、それは抹殺対象として認: It doesn't matter what the intruder's circumstances are. The moment they step inside, they are recognized as a target for extermination.
m900580.倒さなければならない理由が増えたわね。\nもっとも、どのみち逃げることはできない:
That gives us one more reason to defeat it.
Though, in the end, there's no way we can escape anyway.
m900580.加えて、森の外に出ようとする動きも確認できたそうで……。: Moreover, there are signs that it's trying to leave the forest……
m900580.困った神獣だからですかねぇ……。: Is it because it's a troublesome divine beast……?
m900580.実際、神獣フンババの武器に関しては、\nそれくらいの気の持ちようで使えばいいと思:
As for the divine beast Humbaba's weapons,
I think that is the right attitude to have when using them.
m900580.尋常じゃなく殺気立っているというか、\nありえないくらい怒り狂った化け物がいます: It's radiating an abnormal amount of killing intent…… It's a monster that's gone absolutely berserk with rage.
m900580.得るものが全くない不毛な戦いをしてしまったという事実を、\n詩人たちがいい感じに: The poets probably took the fact that it was a futile battle with no gains and spun it into a nice story.
m900580.憎き英雄王の気配を感じたのかしら。\nフンババは今、自分を封じた相手のところに\: It probably sensed the presence of the Hero King it hates. Right now, Humbaba must be desperate to go to the one who sealed it.
m900580.戦う以外にも気を配らなきゃないけないことがあるなんて。\n本当に厄介な神獣なんだ:
There's more to worry about than just fighting.
Humbaba really is a troublesome divine beast.
m900580.放置しておくと、周辺の村や人に、\n被害が出てしまうというわけですか。:
If we leave it alone, it will likely cause harm
to the surrounding villages and people.
m900580.最初は守護獣さんみたいだって思ったけど、違うね。\n神獣フンババは……とっても残:
At first, I thought it might be like the Guardian Beasts, but I was wrong.
The divine beast Humbaba is…… extremely cruel.
m900580.最後まで大暴れしてくれましたが……。\nなんとか、神獣フンババを倒せましたね。: It really put up a fight until the very end... but we managed to defeat the divine beast Humbaba.
m900580.本気を出さざるを得なくなっているわけですからね。\nこの勢いのまま、フンババを仕:
It has no choice but to go all out.
Let's keep up this momentum and put Humbaba down.
m900580.森で暮らしていた者なら、\nだいたいの者が知っている、伝説の存在ですよー。:
If you've lived in the forest, you've probably heard of it.
It's a legendary being, you know.
m900580.森に足を踏み入れた存在を殺す。\nただそれだけよ。: Kill anything that sets foot in the forest. That's all.
m900580.森を守る神獣だからなのかな。\nその伝承や逸話は、各地の自然の中に、\n朧げなが:
Since Humbaba is a divine beast that protects the forest,
its legends and tales seem to linger,
faintly, in the natural landscapes of various regions.
m900580.泥仕合の末になんとか封印した、というのが真実ね。: The truth is that we barely managed to seal it away after a brutal, messy fight.
m900580.王子、此度の神獣フンババ討伐、お疲れ様でした！: Prince, well done on subduing the divine beast Humbaba!
m900580.王子のことを睨んでますね。\nそれはもう、ありったけの憎悪が籠った目つきで。:
It's glaring at the Prince.
With a look filled to the brim with hatred.
m900580.神獣フンババが来ます！\n皆さん、戦闘準備を！:
The divine beast Humbaba is coming!
Everyone, prepare for battle!
m900580.神獣フンババはそうなんですよ。\nあれは、森の番人とは名ばかりの怪物で、\n制御: That's just the name, you see. Humbaba is a monster that's only called a forest guardian in name. It's a divine beast that failed to be controlled.
m900580.神獣一体であれが倒せるのかは分かりませんが……。\nまぁ、それは重要なことではあ:
I don't know if a single divine beast could be defeated by someone like that……
But that's hardly the point.
m900580.私たちはすでにフンババの森に入ってしまった。\nそしてなにより、ここには英雄王の:
We have already entered Humbaba's forest.
And above all, the Prince, descendant of the Hero King, is here with us.
m900580.私たちを絶対に殺すという気になったようですね。: It seems it has resolved to kill us, no matter what.
m900580.自分じゃもうギルガメッシュを倒せないから、\n仕方なく王子にその悲願を託したとか:
Maybe it realized it could no longer defeat Gilgamesh on its own,
and was forced to entrust that desperate wish to the Prince.
m900580.調べてみたところ、あの銃は、\n神獣フンババが自身の魔力で作り上げた物だと分かっ:
I've looked into it, and it turns out that gun
was created by the divine beast Humbaba using its own magic.
m900580.逆になさすぎれば、一気に勝負を決めるために、\n強化形態で襲いかかってくる、とい:
Conversely, if we have too little,
it will attack in its enhanced form to end the fight in one blow.
m900580.重要なのは、フンババの性格上、\n標的を見つけて殺すまで暴れ回るだろうということ:
What matters is that, given Humbaba's nature,
it will rampage until it finds a target and kills it.

m920007.……いや、すまない。\n失ったものを悔やむだけの俺が\n君たちを非難する資格はな: …No, I'm sorry. I have no right to blame you when all I do is mourn what I've lost…
m920007.あの女を仲間にする方法はただ一つ。\n刻水晶をかき集め、ヴァンパイアの支配から\: There's only one way to make that woman your ally: gather the Chronocrystals and free her from the vampire's control.
m920007.あんたが魔物たちと戦っている\n伝説の英雄の末裔ってやつか。: So you're that descendant of the legendary hero who's been battling monsters, huh?
m920007.いろいろと知っているみたいですね。\nもしかして、なぜヴァンパイアがここに現れた: You seem to know a lot. Do you happen to know why the vampires showed up here?
m920007.おそらく、もって２週間、はやければ数日で\nやつらの仲間だ。: In at most two weeks—maybe just a few days—you'll be one of them.
m920007.ここです。\nこの集落ではこの数日、魔物たちの襲撃を\n受けており、中には見慣れ: This is it. In recent days this village has been under monster attacks, and there are reports of unfamiliar creatures as well.
m920007.ここに吸血鬼の隠れ家があるのか？: So this is the vampires' hideout?
m920007.これで終わりでしょうか。\nあっけないですね。: Is that it? That was anticlimactic.
m920007.しかし、一つや二つの刻水晶ではどうしようもない。\n険しい道のりになるだろう。: But a single or even a couple of Chrono Crystals won't be enough. It'll be a tough road.
m920007.じゃあ、もう一度確認しておく。\nお前らはあの吸血鬼女……カルマを\n助けたいと: Alright, let me confirm again. You all want to save that vampire woman… Karma, right?
m920007.そういえば自己紹介がまだだったな。\n俺の名前はヴィンセント。\n見ての通りの流: Speaking of which, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name's Vincent. As you can see, I'm a drifter.
m920007.そうだな……仲間にする方法があるとすれば、\n不思議な力を持つという刻水晶が手に: Well… if there's a way to bring her into the fold, obtaining a Chrono Crystal with mysterious powers might make it possible.
m920007.ついに来たか！\n気を付けろ、やつがあの女を\n襲った吸血鬼だ！: They finally showed up! Stay sharp—those are the vampires that attacked that woman!
m920007.ところで、さっきはなぜ俺を止めた？\nあの娘、近いうちにヴァンパイアになり\n見: By the way, why did you try to stop me earlier? That girl's going to turn into a vampire soon and will start attacking anyone she sees.
m920007.とにかく近づかれる前に一匹でも倒すんだ。: Whatever we do, we have to take down at least one before they get close.
m920007.とんでもない魔物が出てきましたね……\nこれ以上追うのは危険すぎます。: An incredible monster just appeared… Pursuing any further would be too dangerous.
m920007.どうやらここは狼たちの巣みたいだな。\n嫌な予感しかしないぜ。: Looks like this is a wolf den. I've got nothing but a bad feeling.
m920007.どうやら狼の群れが近づいてくるようだな。\nかなりの数のようだ……: A pack of wolves is approaching. Seems like a sizable group…
m920007.なにっ？ 仲間にしたいだと？\nお前は変わった男だな。: What? You want to make her an ally? You're a strange man.
m920007.なんだと！\n俺は一人でも行くぞ。\nじゃあな……: What the—! I'll go alone. See you later…
m920007.ふん、お人好しにもほどがあるな。\nあんたの覚悟が本物か見せてもらおうか。: Hmph, you're a bit too good-hearted. Let's see if your resolve is genuine.
m920007.ふんっ、誰も犠牲にしたくないだって？\nそんな都合の良い方法が……\n！！……本: Huh, you don't want anyone to become a sacrifice? You think there's some convenient solution… Seriously, you actually want to save that girl?
m920007.まあ、心配するな。あんたが失敗したら\n俺が責任をもって彼女にトドメを刺してやる: Don't worry. If you fail, I'll take responsibility and finish her off myself.
m920007.やつらは「ヴァンパイア」だ。\nといっても、ヴァンパイアの中では最も下級で\nレ: Those are vampires. Though, they're the lowest-ranked kind—called Lesser Vampires.
m920007.やつらは迎えに来ているのさ……花嫁を。\nこの集落にヴァンパイアに血を吸われた女: They're coming to fetch her… the bride. There's got to be a woman in this village who was drained by a vampire.
m920007.レッサーヴァンパイアの集団が\nこちらに向かっています。: A horde of Lesser Vampires is heading this way.
m920007.ワーウルフだ。\nやつらには普通の武器は効きにくい。\n魔法か魔法の武器が有効だ: Werewolves. Regular weapons barely work on them. You'll need magic or enchanted weapons.
m920007.下級ヴァンパイアがあんなに沢山…: There are so many low-rank vampires…
m920007.何とか撃退できたみたいですね。\nあの見慣れない魔物はなんだったんでしょうか。: Looks like we managed to drive them off. I wonder what those strange monsters were.
m920007.出会ったばかりの女のために命がけで\n刻水晶を集めるというわけだ。\nとんだお人: So you're risking your lives to collect Chronocrystals for a stranger you just met. What kind of softies you are…
m920007.化け物になる前に殺してやるぜ……: I'll kill you before you turn into a monster…
m920007.女神様、どうかお力をお貸しください。: Goddess, please lend us your strength.
m920007.安心するな、奴らは不死身だ。\nまたすぐに生き返る。\nぐずぐずしてる暇はない。: Don't get comfortable; they're undead. They'll rise again soon. No time to dawdle—let's chase them!
m920007.小娘が知ったふうな口を……: You think you can lecture me, little girl…
m920007.待ってください！\nこのまま先に進んでも死ぬだけです！: Please wait! If we keep going like this, we'll just end up dead!
m920007.最初に犠牲になるのは彼女の近くにいる\n親しい人間だ。\nそうなる前に殺してやる: The first victims will be the people close to her. Killing her now is the only way to save those folks.
m920007.本当にすべての吸血鬼を滅ぼしたいの\nならば、進むべき道は他にあります。: If you truly want to wipe out every vampire, there's another path you should take.
m920007.本物のヴァンパイアの召使、まがい物のような\nものだな……だが油断するなよ。\n: Just a servant of a real vampire, a sort of imposter… But don't let your guard down. They're tough and carry paralytic poison—getting close to them is dangerous.
m920007.気を付けろ。\nそいつの牙には麻痺毒がある。\n攻撃を受け続けると体がしびれて動: Watch out. That thing's fangs are laced with paralytic poison. If you keep getting hit, you'll go numb and won't be able to move.
m920007.永く生きたヴァンパイアは血を吸うことで\n自分の仲間を増やすことができる。\n残: A long-lived vampire can increase its numbers by feeding. Sorry, but it's already too late for you.
m920007.油断するな……\nやつらが近づいてくる！: Don't let your guard down… They're closing in!
m920007.狼の遠吠えが近づいてくる、嫌な予感がするな。: The wolves' howls are getting closer. I've got a bad feeling.
m920007.確かにそこの方がおっしゃるように数日前\nに黒い魔物に襲われ、血を吸われました。: As that person said, a few days ago we were attacked by a black monster and had our blood sucked.
m920007.祈っても無駄だ。\n自分の道は自分で切り開け。: Praying won't help. You have to carve your own path.
m920007.私はカルマと申します。\n国を魔物に滅ぼされ、今は放浪の身……: I'm Karma. My kingdom was destroyed by monsters, and now I wander the lands…
m920007.群れが大きくなればなるほど\nそのリーダーも手強くなる……\n油断するなよ。: The bigger the pack, the tougher the leader gets… Don't let your guard down.
m920007.誰ですかあなたは？\n「やつら」ってなんでしょうか？: Who are you? And what do you mean by “they”?
m920007.（もっと早くあんたらと出会えていたら。\n俺も家族を失わずにすんだかもな……）: (If only I'd met you guys sooner… maybe I wouldn't have lost my family…)

m920030.……どうにも彼女はまだ本気で\n戦っていないように思えます。: …She still doesn't seem to be fighting seriously.
m920030.……まずはだましてごめんね。\nああするしかボクには方法が無かったんだ。: …First of all, I'm sorry for deceiving you. I had no choice but to do that.
m920030.あいたたた、負けちゃったかー。\nこうなったら逃げるしかないね。:
Ouch, ouch—lost, huh?
Looks like I've got to run.
m920030.あいたたたー！\nもう、こっちは手加減してあげて\nいるってのに……！:
Ouch!
I thought I was going easy on you, and this is how you repay me...!
m920030.あの魔物たちの動き。\n何者かに指揮をされているように\n見えます。:
The way those monsters move.
It looks like someone's commanding them.
m920030.あれが噂の王子か。\nあんまり強そうに見えないけど……\nちょっと試してみようか:
So that's the rumored Prince.
He doesn't look that strong... I think I'll give him a little test.
m920030.い、今の嘘！\n次こそは必ず息の根を止めるから！\nじゃあ、またね。:
That was a lie!
Next time I'll definitely end you!
See you later.
m920030.いっておくが、私の死霊魔術が小娘のそれと\n同じと思うな。: Let me make this clear: don't think my necromancy is the same as that little girl's.
m920030.うーん、ちゃんとついてきているのは\nえらいけど、ボクもまだ捕まるわけには\nい:
Hmm, you're doing a good job keeping up,
but I still can't let myself get caught.
m920030.お前たちには最後にふさわしい舞台を用意した。\r\nここでおしまいだ。: I've prepared a fitting finale for you. This is where it ends.
m920030.お父様が王子一行と戯れている間に\n見つけたお父様の魂の器です。: While you were playing with the Prince's party, I found the vessel containing your soul.
m920030.お父様の……死者の王の命により\nあなた達を倒しにきました。\nさあ、覚悟してね:
By my father's... the Dead King's command, I've come to defeat you.
Prepare yourselves.
m920030.こうなったらお父様のお力にすがるしかないかな……。: In that case, I guess I'll have to rely on my father's strength...
m920030.ここまで辿り着いたことは評価に値する。\nその褒美に、私自ら相手してやろう……！: You've earned my respect by making it this far. As a reward, I'll face you myself!
m920030.これで……。早く魂の器を探そう。: That's it… Let's hurry and find the soul vessel.
m920030.これまでとは比べ物にならないくらい手ごわい\r\nから気をつけたほうがいいよ。: He's far more formidable than before, so you should be careful.
m920030.これまでの戦いでは死者の王は\r\n自分が滅びることはないと油断していたけど、\: In the battles so far, the Dead King grew complacent, thinking he couldn't be destroyed. From now on, he'll truly give his all.
m920030.さぁ、我の力でさらに凶悪になった\nアンデッドモンスターたちよ！ やつらを葬れ！: Come, undead monsters, now even more vicious with my power! Bury them!
m920030.さあ、可愛いボクのしもべたち。\n永遠に満たされぬ魂を\n人間どもの悲鳴で慰める:
Come now, my cute minions.
We'll soothe these eternally unsatisfied souls with the screams of humans.
m920030.さあ亡者達よ。\nボク達の恐ろしさを見せてやるんだ！: Come, undead! I'll show you just how terrifying we are!
m920030.さようなら、お父様。\r\nたとえ厳しくても、それでもボクには尊敬する\n父親だ: Farewell, Father. Even though you were strict, you were still a dad I respected.
m920030.しかし亡者達を意のままに操ることなんて\nできるはずが……。: But controlling the undead at will... that shouldn't be possible...
m920030.じゃあ、死者の王の魂の器が\r\n隠されている場所に案内するよ。: Then, I'll guide you to where the Dead King's soul vessel is hidden.
m920030.そう、そのまさかです。\nこの器を破壊させていただきます。: Yes, exactly—that's what I mean. I'll destroy this vessel.
m920030.そう、死者の王は肉体を破壊しても\n滅ぶことはない。: That's right—destroying the Dead King's body won't end him.
m920030.そうだよ。\n偉大なる死霊魔術師である死者の王の娘として\nあなた達を倒さなきゃ: That's right. As the Dead King's daughter, a great necromancer, I have to defeat you.
m920030.その魂を封じた器を破壊しない限りは\n倒すことはできない……。: He can't be truly defeated unless we shatter the vessel that seals his soul.
m920030.それができるんだなー。\n死霊魔術を極めたネクロマンサーなら\nそんなのかーんた:
It is possible, though.
For a necromancer who's mastered death magic, it's a piece of cake.
m920030.それをどうするのだ。\nま、まさかっ。: What are you going to do with it? No—no way...
m920030.そろそろ本気で行くよ。: It's about time I get serious.
m920030.ただ、死者の王はまだ完全には滅んでいない。\n魂の器はあと一つある。それを破壊し: However, the Dead King hasn't been completely vanquished yet. There's one soul vessel left. We have to destroy it to finish him off.
m920030.だからボクはずっと死者の王の隙をうかがって、\n滅ぼすタイミングを待ってたんだよ: So I've been waiting for the right moment to strike at the Dead King's weakness and destroy him.
m920030.でも、父は強大な力と引き換えに\n魔物に魂を売り渡したんだ。: But my father sold his soul to monsters in exchange for overwhelming power.
m920030.どうやら、ボクの力じゃ\nあなた達に勝てないみたいだ。: It seems I can't beat you with my own power.
m920030.なぜ魔物の手先になっているんですか？: Why are you serving the monsters?
m920030.ひぎゃあああああ！！\r\n……まだだ。まだ私は倒れん！\r\n呪われし力よ、我: Hiiiii—! …Not yet. I won't fall yet! Cursed power, grant me your magic…!
m920030.ふふふ、さあ出ておいで\n英雄の末裔の王子さま……。: Hehe, step forward, Prince, descendant of heroes...
m920030.ふふふ、そう簡単には捕まらないさ。\nさあ、ボクはこっちだよ。:
Hehe, you won't catch me that easily.
Come on, I'm over here.
m920030.ふふふ、気をつけてね。\nボクの死霊魔術で強化された亡者たちは\n手ごわいから。: Hehe, be careful. The undead enhanced by my necromancy are pretty tough.
m920030.ふーん。さすがは、ってところだね。\nいいよ。教えてあげる。:
Hmm. As expected.
Fine, I'll tell you.
m920030.まぁ、そのためにちょっと王子の力を試させて貰ったけどね？\nなんせ相手はあの死者: Well, I did get to test the Prince's power a bit, though. After all, the opponent is the Dead King; being just a little strong wouldn't be enough to defeat him.
m920030.まさか私までもが負けるとは……っ。\nだが、これで勝ったと思うなよ……！: I never imagined I'd be defeated... But don't think this means you've won!
