m920030.もうよい、下がれ。\n全く……、我が娘ながら使えぬものよ。\nお前の処分はやつら: That's enough. Stand down. Honestly... even my own daughter is useless. You'll be dealt with after those monsters are buried.
m920030.もう一つの魂の器の場所は見当がついてる。\nそれを破壊する手伝いをしてくれないか: I have an idea where the other soul vessel is. Could you help me destroy it?
m920030.もう覚えてないかもしれないけど、\r\n魔物になる前にあなたはボクに言ったんだ。: You might not remember now, but before you became a monster you told me…
m920030.もし自分が魔物に成り果てることがあったら、\r\nそのときは滅ぼしてほしいって…: …that if you ever turned into a monster, you'd want me to end you.
m920030.やっと追いつきましたよ。\n……メメントさん、あなた人間ですね。\n戦っていると:
We finally caught up.
…Memento, you're actually human.
I can tell by the way you fight.
m920030.アンデッドモンスターに再び私の力を……、\r\n王子たちを倒すのだっ！！！: Let the undead monsters wield my power again… and crush the princes!!
m920030.ボクはスケルトンを呼び出して戦わせる事が\nできるんだよ。: I can summon skeletons to fight for me.
m920030.ボクはメメント。\n死霊魔術を極めたネクロマンサーだよ。:
I'm Memento.
I'm a necromancer who's mastered death magic.
m920030.メメント！\n貴様その手に持っているのは！: Memento! What are you holding in your hand?
m920030.一応ボクも死霊術を操れるから、\n足手まといにはならないと思うよ？: I can still wield necromancy, so I don't think I'll be a burden.
m920030.人間の中にはさ。力を求めて\n自らの体に魔を受けいれるものがいる。: Among humans, there are those who, seeking power, willingly let darkness take over their bodies.
m920030.今回から一緒に戦うわけだけど、\r\nとりあえず最初にボクの能力を説明するね。: We'll be fighting together this time, so first let me explain my abilities.
m920030.何かたくらんでいるかもしれません。\n罠の可能性もあります。\nお気をつけて。: She might be plotting something. It could be a trap, so stay alert.
m920030.何をばかな……！ よせ、やめろ！: What are you saying…! Stop, enough!
m920030.報告！\nこちらにアンデッドの大群が向ってきています！: Report! A massive horde of undead is heading this way!
m920030.報告！\n複数のアンデッドモンスターが暴れている模様！:
Report!
Multiple undead monsters are rampaging!
m920030.報告！ またしても亡者が暴れているようです！\nこちらに向ってきています！:
Report!

m920030.彼はボクの本当の父親じゃないんだよね。\n己の目的のため、彼の勝手な都合で\n養: He's not my real father. He forced me to become his adopted daughter for his own purposes.
m920030.彼は今や人間としての自我なんてない、\n人ならざる者に成り果ててしまったんだよね: Now he has no humanity left—he's become something less than human.
m920030.彼らを回復する事はできないけど、\r\n倒されても戦闘後の★の評価には影響しない: I can't heal them, but even if they fall, it won't affect the post-battle ★ rating, so you can fight without worry.

becoming a monster himself.
m920030.気をつけてください。\nあのネクロマンサーが戦場にいる間は\n亡者たちが強化され: Please be careful. As long as that necromancer is on the battlefield, the undead keep getting stronger.
m920030.気をつけて！\r\n死者の王に操られている人間たちだ。: Watch out! Those humans are being controlled by the King of the Dead.
m920030.父親の命令で私達を襲撃したというわけですか。: So you attacked us on your father's orders, then.
m920030.王を倒して、ボクは呪縛から\n解放されたい。: I want to defeat the King so I can be freed from this curse.
m920030.王子、こちらへ！ 魂の器です！: Prince, over here! The soul vessel!
m920030.王子、すぐに迎え撃ちましょう！: Prince, let's intercept them at once!
m920030.申し訳ありません。お父様。\nボクの力が及ばぬため……。: I'm sorry, Father. My power wasn't enough...
m920030.私は何度でも蘇るのだ！: I will rise again, no matter how many times!
m920030.私は死を克服し、人間を超越した\n存在なのだ！！: I have conquered death and transcended humanity—I am beyond a mere human!
m920030.自らが王子たちを倒すと勇ましく出て行ったのに\nこの様とは。\nお前には失望した: I went out bravely, promising to slay the princes myself, and this is how it ends? I'm disappointed in you.
m920030.血がつながっていないとはいえ、\n親を殺すことに抵抗がないわけじゃない。: Even though we're not blood-related, it doesn't mean I'm comfortable killing a parent.

m920079.――あ、あの軍勢は！？\nルチアさん、見て下さい！ 白の帝国軍です！:
—Uh, that army!?
Lucia, look! It's the White Imperial Army!

—Dwight! What are you daydreaming about!?

Get into combat formation immediately!
m920079.――ラピス様は、私の命を救ってくれた。\nこれ以上、私に付きまとうのなら、\n今:
—Lapis saved my life.
If you continue to cling to me,
this time I'll truly defeat you all.
m920079.――ルチアか！？ \nああ……そうだ、私だ。ずっと、探していたんだ……。\n……:
—Lucia?!
Ah… yes, it's me. I've been searching for you all this time…
…I'm sorry. Because of me… you ended up in a place like this.
m920079.――危ないッ！ ルチアさん！\n一体何をするんですか！ ルチアさんに\n急に攻撃: —Danger! Lucia! What on earth are you doing! Attacking Lucia all of a sudden—aren't you her allies!?
m920079.……。\n国の事などとうに忘れました。\n今は、ラピス様が私の主君です。: …I've long forgotten about that country. Right now, Lapis-sama, you are my lord.
m920079.……。\n（泣いているのか、ルチア……。\n人間の感情はよく分からぬが、帰りたい:
…
(Is she crying, Lucia… I don't really understand human emotions, but she wants to go home?)
m920079.……「元」、白の帝国だ。\n今の主君はここにおられるラピス様。\n他に何も言う事:
…“Former”—the White Empire.
My current master is Lapis, who stands before us.
I have nothing else to say.
m920079.……いや、私は戻れない。今の主君はラピス様。\n今更、白の帝国に……戻るなんて…: …No, I can't go back. My master now is Lady Lapis. It's too late to return to the White Empire… I can't do that…
m920079.……それにしても、あの王子とやら、\nルチアが前に住んでいた国の「皇帝」という人: …Still, I wonder which is stronger—the so-called “Prince,” or the “Emperor” of the country Lucia once lived in.
m920079.……だが、我が軍としても、\n帝国の名を騙る輩の事を、捨て置くわけにもいかない。: …However, we cannot simply ignore those who would tarnish the Empire's name.
m920079.……どうやら、\nあちらに交戦の意思は既に無いようですね。\nルチアさん、私たち: …It seems they have no desire to fight any more. Lucia, let's return to the Material Realm together.
m920079.……ふぅ、この辺りのデーモンは全て片付いたようだな。\nだが、あいつは何者なんだ: …Phew, looks like we've cleared all the demons around here. But who was that? She called herself Lucia, yet she attacked with the demons—what's her deal?!
m920079.……レオナ様……、\nそれに、白の帝国軍……、\n本当に、夢を見ているみたいだ…:
…Lady Leona…
And the White Imperial Army…
It really feels like a dream…
m920079.……レオナ様。\n（非情なレオナ様が、一部隊の為にここまでなさるとは。\nやはり:
…Lady Leona.
(How ruthless of you, Lady Leona, to go this far for a single unit.
You must still be haunted by what happened back then.)
m920079.……何？\n指揮をしていた者は、女性の神官戦士だった、だと？: …What? The commander was a female priest-warrior, you say?
m920079.……敗戦の気色を察して、素早く撤退したか。\nさすがは白の帝国といったところだな: …Sensing defeat, they withdrew quickly. That's typical of the White Empire.
m920079.……考えたくはないですが、\nデーモンと協力関係にあるのでしょう。: …I don't want to think about it, but it looks like they're in league with the demons.
m920079.……！\n白の帝国を知っているのか！？:
…!
You know about the White Empire?!
m920079.あ、あれは……！\n間違いない、さっき俺たちに戦いを吹っ掛けてきた\n神官戦士じ: Ah, that's…! No doubt it's the priest-warrior who just attacked us!
m920079.ああ、そうだ。それが皇帝直筆の親書だ。\nそれをもって、改めて我らは本件に関して: Ah, right. This is the Emperor's own handwritten letter. With this, we reaffirm that we are not involved in this matter.
m920079.あの神官戦士が心配でたまらねぇ。\n王子、すぐに追いかけようぜ！: I'm really worried about that priest-warrior. Prince, let's go after them right now!
m920079.あんた、角と羽は見えてる？\nあれは、どう見てもデーモンよ。\nくだらない邪念は: Hey, can you see the horns and wings? No matter how you look, that's a demon. Drop your petty thoughts.
m920079.いつになく、皆さんのやる気を感じますね。\n急ぎ、彼らを追いましょう。:
I'm actually feeling a surge of motivation from everyone today.
Let's hurry after them.
m920079.うそ……そんな、まさか……あれは、レオナ様！？\n私を助けるために、こんなところ:
No… this can't be… is that… Lady Leona!?
You came all the way here to save me?
m920079.えっ……、\nそ、そんな……冗談、ですよね……ラピス様！？: What…? No… this has to be a joke, right… Lady Lapis!?
m920079.おいおい……どうなってんだ。\n魔界の門がこんなに沢山あるぞ……。\n……どう考: Hey, what the…? There are so many demonic gates… This is clearly abnormal.
m920079.お前は人間なのに、なんでデーモンなんかに\n付き従ってんだ？ デーモンが人間の敵:
You're human, yet you follow demons?
You can't possibly not know that demons are humanity's enemies—
m920079.くそ、よく分からねえが、\nこのままじゃ民の命が危ない……。: Damn it, I don't get it, but if we keep this up the civilians' lives are in danger…
m920079.くそっ……！ また敗けてしまったっ……。\nあの時と同じ……軍に見捨てられた時と: Damn…! I've lost again… Just like that time… when the army abandoned me… If this keeps up, even Lady Lapis will abandon me…!
m920079.くっ……。\n……王子軍がまさかここまで強いなんて……。: Damn… The Prince's army is unbelievably strong…
m920079.げっへっへ。\n今度こそ、このデカ斧で絶対てごめ……\nあっいや、倒してやるぜ！:
Heh heh heh.
This time, with this massive axe, I'll definitely—
Ah, no, I'll crush them!
m920079.ここまで追いかけてくるとは、\n王子軍のしつこさは害虫並みだな。\nお前達、何が:
To think you'd chase us this far—
your army's persistence is as annoying as pests.
What's your purpose? Speak up.
m920079.こちらでも捜索を開始するが、\n貴国側でも、再びその神官戦士を見かける事があれば: We will begin our own investigation, and if you happen to spot that priest-warrior again, please report it to the White Empire.
m920079.し、信じられない……！\nデーモンが人間と共に王国を攻めてくるなんて……！？: I-I can't believe this…! Demons attacking the kingdom alongside humans…?!
m920079.すまない……以前、行方不明となった我が軍の神官戦士やも、\nと思ったのだが、その: I'm sorry… I wondered if it might be one of our priest-warriors who went missing, but that possibility is virtually zero. We're still searching, but we have no leads…
m920079.そうか。\nルチアを魔界の辺境に捨て置いたろくでもない国だ。\n無価値な主君に仕: I see. That country that abandoned you to the demon realm was worthless. There's nothing more pitiful than a soldier serving a worthless lord.
m920079.そうじゃな。デーモンと共に逃げていったところを見るに、\n奴等の後をついていけば: Right. Since they fled with the demons, if we follow their trail we'll pinpoint where the demonic gate opened.
m920079.その先は言うな。\n万が一にも可能性があるならば、\nルチアの一隊を救い出さなけ:
Don't speak of what lies ahead.
If there's even a sliver of a chance, we must rescue Lucia's squad!
m920079.それでは、失礼する。: With that, I take my leave.
m920079.それと、今回の件に際する\n貴国の冷静な対応に重ねて感謝をする。: Also, I wish to thank you for your calm handling of this incident.
m920079.そんな悠長な事を言っている場合ではなさそうだ。\n前線では、既に戦いが始まってし:
We don't have time for such leisurely talk.
The battle's already started at the front.
We must quickly whittle down the enemy forces and neutralize them, or it's dangerous.
m920079.そんな顔をなさらないでください……レオナ様。\n我が帝国軍を疑ってしまった私こそ:
Please don't make that face, Lady Leona.
I should be the one to blame for doubting our Imperial troops.
…But to finally meet you like this, I'm truly… grateful.
m920079.つまり、その神官戦士が侵攻してきたという事は、\n帝国上層の総意も同じであるとい: So the fact that a priest-warrior led the invasion means the empire's higher-ups share the same intent.
m920079.つまり、相当な力を持つデーモンが、\nこれらの魔界の門を開いたという事ですね。: In other words, a demon of considerable strength opened all these gates.
m920079.では、さっそく本題に入ろう。: Now, let's get straight to the point.
m920079.では、帰るぞ。久しぶりの物質界は楽しかった。\n魔界で噂の「王子」も、見ることが: Then let's return. The material world was fun after so long. Seeing the “Prince” everyone's been talking about in the demon realm was a nice distraction.
m920079.とにかく、今は戦う以外に道はないようですね。: In any case, it seems fighting is the only option now.
m920079.とはいえ、早計な行動は取るべきではないと思います。\n……王子、私はすぐに白の帝:
Still, I don't think we should act rashly.
…Prince, I'll send a letter to the White Empire right away, asking whether this battle is truly their intention.
m920079.な、なんだよ、もちろん、見えてるぜ……！\n女のデーモンって訳か。\n魔法よりも: Wh-what? Of course I can see them…! So it's a female demon. Might as well swing my big axe instead of using magic!
m920079.なんとか、話合いで解決する事は\n出来ないのでしょうか……？: Can't we resolve this through talks…?
m920079.はい、ラピス様。\n魔界をあてもなくさまよっていた時、\nラピス様に救われた御恩: Yes, Lapis-sama. When I was wandering the demon realm with nowhere to go, you saved me. I could never forget that debt.
m920079.ふふ。領内への突然の侵攻に、\n王子軍も対応が遅れているようだね。: Heh. The sudden incursion into our lands has even caught the Prince's forces off guard.
m920079.ふむ。デーモンの出現は、\n魔界の門が、ここ物質界のどこかで開いた証拠じゃ。\n:
Hmm. A demon's emergence indicates a gate to the demon realm has opened somewhere in this material world.
We must deal with it quickly or things will get serious.
m920079.ふむ。魔界の瘴気の濃度が薄い……。\nおそらく、魔界の表層階じゃろう。: Hmm. The miasma here is thin… It's probably the surface layer of the demon realm.
m920079.まさかルチア……なのか……？\nいや……しかし、あいつはあの時、魔界で……。: Could it be Lucia…? No… but she was in the Demon Realm at that time…
m920079.また、人間が来たのか……。\nわたしはさっき大切なものを失ったばかりで、\n少し:
Humans again, huh…
I just lost something precious, so I'm a little on edge. I won't hold back.
m920079.やはり、貴方は白の帝国の神官戦士だったのですね。: So you were indeed a priest-warrior of the White Empire.
m920079.ら、ラピス様！？\n今の戦いをご覧になっていたのですか……！\nも、申し訳ありま: L-Lapis-sama!? Were you watching the fight…! I—I'm sorry… it's all my fault for being so useless!
m920079.れ、レオナ様が……ッ！？\n……私は、見捨てられた訳ではなかったのか……？\n今: Le-Leona…!? …So I wasn't abandoned after all…? Even now, she…
m920079.ん！？ おほっ、見ろよ！\nなんだあのセクシーな赤肌の姉ちゃんは……！: Huh!? Whoa, look! Who's that sexy red-skinned sister…!
m920079.デーモンだって！？\nおいおい、何の冗談だよ！\nこんなこと、今まで殆どなかった:
A demon?! Come on, is this a joke?
This almost never happens…
m920079.デーモンの撤退を確認！\n良かった、これだけの被害で済んだのは奇跡です。:
Demon retreat confirmed!
Thank goodness it was only this much damage—truly a miracle.
m920079.デーモン達が逃げたぞ！\nったく、このまま逃げ切れると思うなよ。:
The demons have fled!
Don't think you can get away that easily.
m920079.デーモン達よ、今こそ王子を倒す好機だ！\n進撃を開始せよ！: Demons, now is your chance to strike down the Prince! Begin the assault!
m920079.ルチアがこんなにあっさり敗れるなんて、\n噂通り、相手はかなり強いみたいだな。: ???: I can't believe Lucia fell so easily—just as the rumors said, the opponent must be pretty strong.
m920079.ルチアさん……！ 聞いて下さい！ \n帝国は貴方のことを見捨ててなどいません！\: Lucia…! Please listen! The Empire hasn't abandoned you! Lady Leona is still searching for you.
m920079.ルチアさん、相手は本気です。早くこちらへ！\n総員、ルチアさんを守るよう、陣形を: Lucia, the enemy is serious. Get over here quickly! Everyone, form a formation to protect her!
m920079.ルチアという名の神官戦士だが、\nデーモンを先導して、ここまで移動したのを\n確: The priest-warrior named Lucia led the demons here, and we've confirmed she's the one moving them.
m920079.ルチア様、このまま戦いを続ければ、\n全滅は免れないかと……。: Lady Lucia, if we keep fighting like this, total annihilation seems inevitable…
m920079.レオナ様、この辺りにも痕跡はありません。\nあれから随分と時が経っていますし、\:
Lady Leona, there's no trace around here.
It's been a long time since then, and we've searched dozens of times. I suppose… that's it.
m920079.了解しました！ \n総員、ルチア様に続けッ！: Understood! All units, follow Lady Lucia!
m920079.了解！ \n追撃を警戒しつつ、撤退を開始します！:
Understood!
We'll begin retreat while watching for pursuit!
m920079.人数が多いな。さすがに殺すのは無理か。\nこれ以上、無駄な戦いをするつもりもない: There are too many of you. I can't possibly kill you all. I have no intention of fighting any longer. Then, I'll take my leave.
m920079.他の仲間達もお前を心配している。\nさあ、すぐに帝国へ帰還しよう。\n皇帝にも、:
The others are worried about you too.
Come, let's return to the Empire right away.
We must report your safe return to the Emperor.
m920079.仲間……？ 何を勘違いしているのだ？\nこいつは退屈しのぎのただのペットだ。\n: Ally…? What are you misunderstanding? She's just a bored pet. This battle showed she's useless to me.
m920079.作戦を変更する！\n「あの場所」まで王子軍をおびき寄せ、\nそこで決着をつける！: Change the plan! Lure the Prince's forces to that spot and settle it there!
m920079.先日、貴国が我が帝国軍からの攻撃を受けたという件だが、\nその部隊は、我ら帝国軍: Regarding the recent incident where your country was attacked by forces claiming to be ours, those troops have no affiliation with the Imperial Army.
m920079.分かりました。\n王子、すぐに戦いの準備をお願いします！: Understood. Prince, please prepare for battle at once!
m920079.前線より、指揮官は神官戦士という報告を受けています。\n体力を削いでも、自身の治:
We've received reports from the front that the commanders are priest-warriors.
Even if we wear them down, they can heal themselves.
All unit leaders, stay alert!
m920079.厄介なことになりそうじゃな……。\n魔界の門は、デーモンの中でも高い力を持つ、\: This is going to get messy… Only high-ranking demons, who wield great power, can create such gates.
m920079.同意です！\nここは皆で力を合わせて、捕獲……、\nではなくて、えっと……戦いま:
I agree!
We should all combine our strength and capture—
no, uh… fight them!
m920079.報告、感謝する。\n確かに、この辺りが潮時のようだね。\n総員、ただちに撤退準備:
Report received, thank you.
Indeed, this area looks like the turning point.
Everyone, prepare to retreat immediately! Withdraw to the designated point!
m920079.報告！\n魔界の門よりデーモンが出現！: Report! Demons are emerging from the demonic gate!
m920079.待って下さい、デーモンの群の中に、\n人間の姿があります……！: Please wait—among the demon horde, there's a human shape…!
m920079.待つのだ、ルチア。\nわたしが、奴らに魔界の怖さを少し教えてやる。:
Hold on, Lucia.
I'll give those demons a taste of the Demon Realm's terror.
m920079.急ぎましょう、王子！ それに「ルチア」という名前……\nレオナさんが言っていた方: Let's hurry, Prince! And that name “Lucia”… it's the same as the one Leona talked about. It can't be a coincidence.
m920079.恐らく野盗の類が、どこぞの戦場から我が軍の武装を\n盗みとり、白の帝国を騙ってい: Most likely, bandits have seized weapons from some battlefield and are masquerading as the White Empire.
m920079.感心してる場合ではないぞ、ユリアン。\n少数ではあったが、白の帝国側に敵意がある:
Don't be impressed, Julian.
Though few, the White Empire's hostility is clear.
Having a priest-warrior as unit commander proves it.
m920079.政務官殿からの書簡は読ませてもらった。\n……書面のみの返答では無用な誤解を生む: I've read the correspondence from the Minister of State. …I thought a written reply alone might cause unnecessary misunderstandings, so I came personally. I hope you understand.
m920079.最初のデーモンの出現から、そう刻は経っておらぬ。\n魔界の門は暫くは消えないはず: Not even an hour's passed since the first demon appeared. The gate shouldn't disappear any time soon. If we're going to chase them, now's the time.
m920079.気にするな。\n堅苦しいのは好かぬ。: Don't worry about it. I don't care for stiff formalities.
m920079.物質界に住む者は、\n魔界の瘴気の影響で、普段の力を発揮できません。\n各部隊長:
Those of us from the material world can't fully use our power
because of the demonic miasma's influence.
All unit commanders, make sure to warn your troops!
m920079.王子、こっちだ。\n今ならまだ神官戦士に追いつけるはず。: Prince, this way. We should still be able to catch up to the priest-warrior.
m920079.王子、ルチアさんが\n帝国に戻ることができて、本当に良かったですね。\nそれでは:
Prince, I'm so glad Lucia can return to the Empire safely.
Then, let's head back as well.
m920079.王子、ルチアさんが、\nデーモンと共に魔界の門に入って行きます……！: Prince, Lucia is entering the demonic gate with the demons…!
m920079.王子、大変だ！\n領内にデーモンが現れたぞ！:
Prince, it's urgent!
A demon has appeared in our territory!
m920079.王子、帝国軍がデーモンと戦闘に入った様です！\n私たちもレオナさん達に加勢しまし:
Prince, the Imperial forces have engaged the demons!
Let's lend our support to Leona and the others!
m920079.王子、急ぎ応戦しましょう。: Prince, we must rush to meet them.
m920079.王子、急ぎ戦闘のご準備を。\n私は白の帝国に急使を送り、この事を伝えます。: Prince, prepare for battle quickly. I'll send an urgent message to the White Empire and inform them.
m920079.王子、早く追いかけないと見失うわ！\n追撃の準備は出来てます！\n早くご指示を！:
Prince, if we don't chase them now we'll lose them!
We're ready for a pursuit!
Give the order!
m920079.白の帝国に戻った方が良いのではないですか？\n貴方を待っている者がいるのですし。: Wouldn't it be better to return to the White Empire? There are people waiting for you.
m920079.白の帝国は、軍事国家ではあるが、\n女神アダマスへの信仰は厚い。だから、神官戦士:
The White Empire is a militaristic nation, but they revere the goddess Adamas deeply.
Thus priest-warriors are granted great authority and status within the empire.
m920079.白の帝国軍、軍師レオナだ。\nこの度は、白の帝国を代表する特使として貴国に参った: I am Leona, strategist of the White Imperial Army. I have come to your nation as a special envoy representing the White Empire, and I carry a personal letter from His Imperial Majesty.
m920079.白の帝国軍が我が軍を攻撃してるというのですか！？\n同盟を結んでいないとはいえ、:
The White Empire troops are attacking us?!
Even though we aren't allied, we had relatively good relations lately, and now they suddenly become hostile…
m920079.皆さん、ここは表層階とはいえ魔界です。\n油断は命取りですよ。:
Everyone, even though this is just the surface layer, it's still the Demon Realm.
Let your guard down and you'll pay with your life.
m920079.私も加勢しますぞ、モーティマ殿。\n女性型のデーモンなど実にけしからん……ではな:
I'll lend my aid as well, Mortimer.
Those female-type demons are simply abhorrent… I mean,
they're extremely dangerous, ahem.
m920079.第三者の下らぬ行動が、\n予期せぬ国家同士の争いに繋がるなど、\nあまりにも滑稽: It's absurd that a third party's petty actions could spark an unintended conflict between nations—far too comical.
m920079.色々と、ありがとう。貴方たちがいなければ、\n私はレオナ様に会えなかった。それば: Thank you for everything. If it weren't for you, I never would have met Lady Leona—and I'd have been stuck as a demon's servant forever in the demon realm.
m920079.落ち着いたら、改めて礼をさせてほしい。\nそれでは、いずれまた会おう……王子。: When things calm down, I want to thank you properly. Until we meet again… Prince.
m920079.落ち着け、ユリアン。\n結論を急いても意味はない。\nとにかく、今は彼女たちを追: Calm down, Julian. Rushing to a conclusion won't help. For now, let's chase after them.
m920079.見たところ、帝国軍にしては\nかなりの小規模部隊に見える。\n帝国軍が少数の部隊:
From what I see, this is a rather small unit for Imperial troops.
It's odd they'd operate with such a small force…
m920079.貴国も知っての通り、今や魔物の攻勢は苛烈さを増している。\n他国に国の内情を晒し: As you're well aware, the monster onslaught has grown ever more ferocious. We don't wish to expose our internal situation to other nations, but the majority of our forces are devoted to defense… that's the state of our army.
m920079.貴方が連れているルチアという女性ですが、\n白の帝国の者ではないのでしょうか？: The woman you're with, Lucia—she isn't from the White Empire, is she?
m920079.近づいただけで体力を奪う……！？\n王子、むやみにラピスというデーモンの近くに\: Just by getting close, it drains my HP…! Prince, please be careful not to recklessly station troops near that demon Lapis!
m920079.驚いた……。これ程の人間が物質界に存在していたとはな。\nだが、これ以上の遊びに:
Astonishing… I never imagined humans could exist in the material world.
But I'm not yet interested enough to keep playing with you.
m920079.（……所詮はデーモンと人間、何もかもが違いすぎる。\nわたしと共に歩むことなど、: (...In the end, demons and humans are just too different. I guess I can't walk alongside her.)
m920079.（ルチア……！？\nレオナさんが口にしていた名前と同じ……。\nやはり、行方不明: (Lucia…!? It's the same name Leona mentioned… Could it be the missing priest-warrior…?)
m920079.（下級デーモン達になぶり殺しにされかけていたルチアを\n気まぐれで救ってやったら: (When I whimsically saved Lucia from being torn apart by lower demons, she grew attached to me, and before I knew it I was feeling emotions I couldn't even name toward her.)
m920079.（国をあげての、初めての魔界遠征だったのだ……。\nあれ程苛烈なデーモンの攻勢な:
(It was the nation's first expedition into the demon realm….
We could never have foreseen such a ferocious demon onslaught.
And yet no one dares to blame your command…)

m920168.――いたたたた……。\n寝起きで降下ポッドはきっついなぁ……。:
――Ow, ow, ow…….
Descending in a pod right after waking up is rough……
m920168.――これは神に挑む戦いなれば、\n神頼みよりも、王子の絆頼みといったところでしょ:
――This is a battle that challenges the gods themselves, so
rather than relying on the gods, we should rely on the Prince's bonds, wouldn't you say?
m920168.――よし、戻ってきたぞ世界樹へ！\nここからが世界樹奪還作戦、第二フェイズだ！:
――All right, back to the World Tree!
This is Phase Two of the World Tree Recovery Operation!
m920168.――ギリギリだ、ギリギリ足りる。\n「世界樹の核」の魔力の波動的に、\n誰も失敗:
――It's cutting it close, but it should just barely be enough.
Based on the mana fluctuations of the "Core of the World Tree,"
if no one makes a mistake, we can just barely make it in time!
m920168.――到着を待っていたら、\n「世界樹の核」が孵化するだろうね。:
――If we wait for them to arrive,
the "Core of the World Tree" will hatch.
m920168.――否定。\n世界樹の中心付近より、\nラタトスク様の魔力が感じられます。:
――Negative.
I can sense Lady Ratatosk's magic power
near the center of the World Tree.
m920168.――愚かな物質界の者どもよ。\n世界樹そのものに抗おうとは、実に愚かだ。:
――Foolish denizens of the material world.
To defy the World Tree itself is truly the height of folly.
m920168.――来たぞ、世界樹のふもと！\nあの洞から内部に侵入するぞ！:
—We've arrived at the base of the World Tree!
We'll enter through that cave!
m920168.…………ラーワル。\n王子、あれは味方よ！！:
…………Rawal.
Prince, that one is on our side!
m920168.……お前が来たってことは、\nあいつも物質界に下りてきてんのか？:
……If you've come down,
does that mean he's descended to the material world too?
m920168.……ごめん。これはぼくの計算ミスだ。\n世界樹の魔物化の進行が速すぎた……。:
……I'm sorry. This was my miscalculation.
The World Tree's corruption is progressing too fast……
m920168.……そう、だね。\nごめん、焦りすぎた。\nみんな！ 知恵を貸してくれ！:
……You're right, I guess.
Sorry, I got too worked up.
Everyone! Lend me your wisdom!
m920168.……ふふん、それもそうか！\n――それからラーワル殿、\nこれからも助力を期待し:
……Heh, fair point!
――And, Lord Rawal,
can I count on your help going forward?
m920168.……ほら、来たぞ最後のひとかけらが。\n誰かが繋いで、王子に至った最後のピースが:
……There, the last piece has arrived.
The final piece that someone connected to reach the Prince!
m920168.……まずいな。\nこの進軍速度じゃ間に合わなくなるぞ。:
……This is bad.
At this pace, we won't make it in time.
m920168.……何だ、この気配は。\nこれまでにない規模で魔物が発生しているぞ。:
……What is this presence?
The monsters are spawning on a scale I've never seen before.
m920168.「あとふたりの僕」は、キミの指揮に任せたよ。\n世界の未来は終わらせない。\nキ:
My two other selves are in your hands, then.
I won't let the world's future end here.
Let me help you seize the chance you've connected!
m920168.「世界樹の核」とは、創造神の遺構ビフロストそのもの。\n正しい手順を踏めば、\n:
The "Core of the World Tree" is the Bifrost, a relic of the Creator God.
If we had followed the proper procedure,
the World Tree would have accepted us.
m920168.あ、れは……？\n砲弾のようなものの中から、女の子が……？:
Wh-What is……?
A girl is coming out of something like a shell……?
m920168.ああ。でも、止まる気はないんだろう？: Yes. But you're not going to stop, are you?
m920168.あと一歩だけ、足りないんでしょ？\n僕が、正義の味方が、キミと共に戦おう！:
You're just one step short, aren't you?
I'll fight by your side! Your justice ally, I mean!
m920168.あの内部に入ったら、\n僕らは敵として襲撃されちゃうってこと？:
So if we enter inside,
we'll be attacked as enemies?
m920168.あれは、ヤドリギ……？\nいえ、でもヤドリギに獣を操るような作用は……。:
Is that mistletoe...?
No, but mistletoe doesn't have properties that control beasts...
m920168.あれは星じゃない……。\n皆、避けて！ ここに落ちるよ！！:
Those aren't stars…….
Everyone, get out of the way! They're going to land right here!!
m920168.あれは毒胞子を撒くキノコだな……。\n身体に寄生させているということか。:
Those are spore-spreading mushrooms……
They're parasitizing the bodies, I see.
m920168.あんなの無かったですよぉ。\n世界樹自体が歪んじゃってます……。:
There definitely wasn't.
The World Tree itself is distorted...
m920168.あーもう！ 暗い顔をするな！\nお前たち軍師だろう！ 天才秀才ばかりだろう！:
Oh, come on! Stop with those grim faces!
You're the strategists, aren't you? A bunch of genius prodigies!
m920168.いいえ、まだその時ではありません。\nまだ世界は終わっていない。\n私は世界の味:
No, that time has not yet come.
The world has not yet ended.
I am on the side of the world, and I cannot give up.
m920168.いや、世界樹にはもとから、\nあるものを隠しておく機能が備わっているんだよ。:
No, the World Tree originally has a function
for hiding certain things away.
m920168.いや、待つのじゃ。\nなんじゃこの地響きは……？:
No, wait.
What is that rumbling...?
m920168.うるせぇ！ ほら、進軍するぞ！\n世界樹の中には、\nまだ魔物化に抵抗してる無謀:
Shut up! Come on, let's advance!
Inside the World Tree,
there's a reckless girl still resisting the monsterization.
m920168.お前のお気に入りの人類も、とうとう、\nオリュンポスにたどり着くことすらなかった:
Even your beloved humanity has failed.
They never even managed to reach Olympus, did they?
m920168.ここで足止めなんてくらってる暇はないぞ。\n王子、フォレストボアには悪いが、\n:
We don't have time to be held up here.
Prince, I'm sorry about the Forest Boar,
but we have no choice but to take it down with everything we've got!
m920168.こちらの戦力以上に、\n世界樹から放たれる魔物が多すぎる。\nもしや連中、世界樹:
There are far too many monsters being released from the World Tree
for our current forces to handle.
Could it be that they're feeding on the World Tree's mana?
m920168.この声は……トラムちゃん！\nよーし、ちゃんと狙いどおり着地できたー！:
That voice… it's Tram-chan!
All right, I landed exactly where I aimed for!
m920168.これは、森の嘆きの声だ。\n世界樹を覆う広大な森の全てが、\n森の主の変貌を嘆き:
This is the forest's cry of anguish.
The entire vast forest that covers the World Tree
is mourning and screaming over the Master of the Forest's transformation.
m920168.さて、それはどうでしょう。\nまだ魔物化は完了しておらず、\n人もまた、諦めてい:
Well, I'm not so sure about that.
The transformation is not yet complete,
and it seems the humans have not given up, either.
m920168.しかし、ここには大勢の仲間がいるのだぞ？\nひとりで考えるより、全員で考えた方が:
But we have a great many comrades here, don't we?
Thinking together will be faster than you trying to solve it alone.
m920168.せめて作戦を聞いてから走り出してくれ。\nそれに、マリレーヌなら分かるだろう？\:
At least wait until you've heard the plan before you start running.
Besides, you should be able to tell, right?
The aura of monsters filling the World Tree.
m920168.そうですね。\n王子、このまま世界樹まで一気に進軍しましょう。:
I agree.
Prince, let's advance straight to the World Tree.
m920168.そう泣きそうな顔をするな。\n大丈夫だ、ぼくらは間に合ったんだよ。:
Don't look so on the verge of tears.
It's all right. We made it in time.
m920168.それなら、助けに行くしかないな。\n世界樹まであと少し、気合入れろよ、王子！:
Then we have no choice but to go save her.
We're close to the World Tree now. Keep it up, Prince!
m920168.そろそろ、諦めたらどうだ。\n人に許されし唯一の感情は諦めなのだから。:
Perhaps it is time you did.
Surrender is the only emotion permitted to your kind.
m920168.だから作戦が必要なんだよ。\nでも、この規模なら想定の範囲内だ。:
That's exactly why we need a plan.
But even at this scale, it's still within our expectations.
m920168.だが、今は違う。\n魔物化の進行した世界樹は、人類を敵と認識した。:
But that's not the case now.
The World Tree, which has progressed in its monsterization,
recognizes humanity as the enemy.
m920168.ですが、過酷な作戦であることに変わりはありません。\nせめてあとひとつ、何か条件:
However, it remains a grueling operation.
If only we could add just one more condition……
m920168.でっかいイノシシだー！\n――って、あれ？ 背中に何か生えてる？:
A giant boar!
—Wait, is something growing on its back?
m920168.でも、これはぼくの責任だ。\n何か解決策を、絶対、何か、うぅぅっ。:
But this is my responsibility.
There has to be a solution. There has to be something. Ugh……
m920168.でも、よく計算してくれた。\n少しの可能性があるなら、\nボクらがそれを、現実に:
But, thank you for calculating it so carefully.
If there's even a slight chance,
we can build a plan to make that a reality.
m920168.ともあれ、移動しながら話そう。\n間に合ったとは言っても、\nのんびりしていたら:
Anyway, let's talk while we move.
Even though we made it in time,
if we dawdle, we'll run out of time!
m920168.な、なんだよ王子。\nマリレーヌまで……。:
W-What is it, Prince?
Even Marylene……
m920168.ならば、答えはひとつ。\n魔物化したヤドリギが、\n獣すら暴走させているというこ:
Then there is only one answer.
Mistletos that has turned into a monster
is causing even the beasts to go berserk.
m920168.はぁ……はぁ……。\nよし、だいぶ近づいたぞ……。\n後はのぼるだけ、だな……！:
Haa... haa...
We're getting close now...
All that's left is to climb...!
m920168.はぁ、千年ぶりの世界！\nちょっと楽しくなってきちゃったぞぉ！:
Ahh, the world after a thousand years!
I'm getting a little excited!
m920168.ふふん、もちろんだとも。\nそしてその災厄が何を指すのかもね。:
Heh, of course I did.
And I know exactly what that calamity entails, too.
m920168.まだ「世界樹の核」は孵化していない。\n世界樹の災厄は、まだ始まっていないんだ。:
The "Core of the World Tree" hasn't hatched yet.
The calamity of the World Tree hasn't even begun.
m920168.まったく、僕は千年寝てたんだぞぉ……？\n戻ったらパパのほっぺ、全力でつねってや:
Seriously, I was asleep for a thousand years……?
When I get back, I'm going to pinch Papa's cheeks with all my might……
m920168.もちろんだともー！\n偽りの命なれど、僕の正義の志は世界一！\n世界を守ろうとす:
You bet on it!
Even if my life is a lie, my justice is the greatest in the world!
If you're trying to save the world, I'll help with everything I've got!
m920168.やれやれ、また暗躍してやがるのか、あいつは。\nだが、お前が来てくれたなら心強い:
Tsk, so he's scheming in the shadows again.
But it's a relief to have you here.
m920168.よぉし、間に合うぞ！\n――いや、それにしてもすごいよ王子！:
All right, we made it in time!
――No, seriously, Prince, that was incredible!
m920168.んん……？\n世界樹に穴をあけちゃうんですか！？:
Hm...?
Are you going to make a hole in the World Tree!?
m920168.アトにぃ、素直になったねぇ……。\nうんうん、妹分として嬉しいよ。:
Atnies, you've gotten pretty open…
Mm-hmm, I'm glad, as your little sister.
m920168.アトナテスお兄ちゃん！ おっひさー！\nんー、パパのことだよね、\nパパは天界で:
Big brother Atnates! Long time no see!
Hmm, you mean Papa, right?
He said he had things to do in the Celestial Realm?
m920168.アナベラ殿は、頭がとてもいい。\nそれは皆が認めるところだ。:
Lady Anabella, you are remarkably intelligent.
That is something we all agree on.
m920168.キミが王子？ おぉ、英雄王くんの面影アリ！: You're the Prince? Oh, you've got the look of the Hero King in you!
m920168.ヤドリギが獣を暴走させ、\n傷つけばヤドリギ自体が傷を癒やす……。\nこれは、許:
The mistletoe drives the beasts mad,
and when they are hurt, the mistletoe itself heals the wounds...
This is an unforgivable blasphemy against the forest...
m920168.ラタトスクちゃん、ここまで魔物化が進んだ以上、\n無事に避難してくれてるといいん:
Ratatosk-chan… with the monsterization this advanced,
I hope she was able to evacuate safely…
m920168.ラタトスク様……どうかご無事で！\n行くぞ王子殿、世界樹は目前だ！:
Ratatosk…… please be safe!
Come on, Your Highness! The World Tree is right before us!
m920168.ラタトスク様も待っているはずだ。\nさぁ、急いで世界樹のふもとへ――んぐっ！？\:
Ratatosk must be waiting for us.
Come on, let's hurry to the foot of the World Tree―Ugh!?
What are you doing, my friend Anabella!!
m920168.ラーワル、だって……？\n英傑アージェに並ぶ人造生命、\n千年戦争を戦った、正義:
Rawal, you say…?
The artificial lifeform that rivals the Hero Arge,
the incarnation of justice who fought the Millennium War, Rawal!?
m920168.不服そうだな、くくっ……。\nだが、もう遅い、手遅れだ。:
You look displeased, heh….
But it is too late now. It is already done.
m920168.世界樹の幹に、巨大な入り口が開くのは想定どおりだよ。\nいや、本当はぼくらが開く:
It was expected for a massive entrance to open in the World Tree's trunk.
No, actually, it was supposed to be us who opened it...
m920168.世界樹の樹液が魔物化した個体のようです。\n微かに似通った魔力が感じられます。:
It appears to be an individual formed from the World Tree's sap.
I can detect a faintly similar mana signature.
m920168.世界樹の災厄……！\nアナベラさん、ご存知だったんですか！？:
The calamity of the World Tree……!
Anabella, you knew about this?
m920168.世界樹の魔物化はじきに達成される。\nもはや秒読みにも等しい。:
The World Tree's transformation into a monster is nearly complete.
We are now counting down the final seconds.
m920168.世界樹を覆う魔力も歪みきっています。\nこれは魔神や神獣にも匹敵する、\nめちゃ:
The mana enveloping the World Tree is completely distorted.
It's a level of chaos that rivals even the Demon Gods and Divine Beasts……
m920168.争い、憎みあい、大地を汚す愚かな被造物。\n創造神の残した愚かな塵芥ども。:
Foolish creations who quarrel, hate one another, and defile the earth.
Wretched dust left behind by the Creator God.
m920168.亜神トラム、亜神クラールフが手を貸そうとも、\n奴らには神の楔が足りていない。:
Even if the Lesser Gods Tram and Kralph lend their aid,
they lack the divine wedges required.
m920168.北の大国は手薄になる王国の防衛に回っていますし、\n砂漠の国、西方の国、雪の国は:
The northern great power is diverting forces to defend the weakened kingdom,
and the desert nation, the western nation, and the snowy nation are
in the thick of defensive battles against the angelic armies that have appeared……
m920168.天才は笑え！ 自信満々であれ！\nほら、空を見上げて――見上げ……うん？:
Geniuses should smile! Be full of confidence!
Come on, look up at the sky――look up……hmm?
m920168.幸い、今は暴れまわっているだけのようだ。\n遠距離からの攻撃を集中させて突破する:
Fortunately, it seems to be just rampaging for now.
Let's focus our ranged attacks to break through!
m920168.心臓に悪いし胃にも悪い……。\n正直帰りたいくらいだ……。:

m920225.分かってる。\nでも、門を破壊するだけの時間は……。\n都市内へ侵入する手段に心: I know. But we don't have time to just break the gates down. Do you have any idea how we can get inside the city?

Being cut up is nice, too…

It's not unprecedented, but…

If we hadn't cooperated with the rebellion...

Keep still.

How rude!

The prisoner's claim that he was holding a knife

While under constant surveillance?

Your Highness……?

m920225.申し遅れました。\nワタシはアイゼルフ、鋼の都警備部隊の工兵です。: Pardon the late introduction. I'm Izelf, an engineer with the Steel City Guard Corps.

Everyone, battle stations!
